name: Statistical uncertainty
description: Most main and extension tables are aggregate point estimates; seed dispersion, significance, split and traffic details are absent.

name: Simulation-setting inconsistency
description: The p.27 prose and Table 6 give different simulated impression-opportunity ranges: 100–500 versus 50–300.

name: Unreported deployment details
description: PDF does not report traffic split/randomization, contamination control, wall-clock/FLOPs, or per-advertiser outcome dispersion.

name: diffusion_policy_gap

name: limited_interaction
description: β and J_f are introduced for limited fine-tuning interaction; β is budget-dependent.

name: theorem41_assumption
description: Theorem 4.1 relies on discrete spaces and i.i.d. uniform state-distribution points on H; continuous case is only a one-step example.

description: Theorem 4.2 assumes exact Q policy iteration and adds compressed-mapping/fixed-point regularity for convergence; practical IQL/CEP approximation is not covered by the proof.

name: benchmark_scope
description: Experiments cover Maze2d, state-based DMC/URLB and two cross-embodiment domains; no visual or robot deployment evaluation.

name: compute_cost
description: ExDM pre-training takes around 0.5 days per maze2d seed/domain and 2 days per URLB seed/domain on the listed hardware.

name: robustness_interoperability
description: Ethics Statement acknowledges deep networks lack interoperability and may face robustness issues, without corresponding robustness experiments.

name: real_world_validation
description: No real-world control, human evaluation or participant-level evidence appears; real-world applications remain a future direction.

name: dedicated limitations section
description: Section 6 proceeds directly to ethics/reproducibility; no Limitations heading.

name: cell-line scope
description: Main experiment has two human cell lines; H1 is appendix-only.

name: task and label scope
description: CAGE is a proxy and only protein-coding genes are listed.

name: causal identifiability
description: C is latent, uniform prior is assumed, X-H independence is assumed, and no causal ground truth is provided.

name: representation averaging
description: Appendix F.3 calls it an approximation; exact equivalence requires a linear head.

name: baseline provenance
description: Baseline results are directly cited and Prism reuses Seq2Exp hyperparameters without extensive tuning.

name: training chromosome list
description: Validation and test chromosomes are given; training chromosomes are not enumerated.

name: uncertainty reporting
description: Main Table 1 names five seeds and SD; appendix dispersion layers are not uniformly specified and no CI/test is given.

name: compute cost
description: Table 3 compares parameter counts only; runtime, memory, and throughput are absent.

name: learned-state semantics
description: Three sampled genes show structure; activating/suppressive labels lack biological validation.

name: long-range biological scope
description: Model context findings do not establish that distal enhancers are biologically unimportant.

name: inferential statistics
description: No p-values, hypothesis tests, multiple-comparison correction, or effect-size uncertainty.

name: ethics and data governance
description: Ethics Statement only references the ICLR Code of Ethics; no dataset governance discussion.

name: finite-training likelihood correctness
description: The paper says likelihoods are empirically good enough but cannot be efficiently guaranteed theoretically; propositions are ideal-minimizer results.

name: true one-step generation
description: Current models do not reach true one-step generation.

name: application scope
description: Experiments focus on molecular-conformation Boltzmann Generation; Bayesian inference and robotics are future work.

name: AL6 metadata
description: The dataset paragraph lists temperature/force-field settings for three molecules although four systems are evaluated; AL6 settings are not separately given.

name: evaluation denominator
description: Table 3 says 2×10^5 evaluations while Appendix D.1 says 10^4 proposal samples and equal resampling/metric count.

name: supplementary package
description: No separate supplementary file is present in the local corpus; Appendix A–F is inside the 25-page PDF.

name: past_data_access
description: The study assumes access to past data and does not evaluate restricted-data scenarios.

name: llm_scale
description: Only relatively small LLMs are used for continual pretraining.

name: llm_scope
description: Continual fine-tuning of LLMs is not evaluated.

name: theory_assumptions
description: Theory requires whitened inputs, fixed ReLU gates or positive-homogeneous/Gaussian conditions, and ε<1 where stated.

name: rank_dormancy_measurement
description: Effective rank and dormant-neuron consequences are proved/discussed but not measured in the reported experiments.

name: statistics
description: No hypothesis tests, numerical uncertainty definition, multiple-comparison correction, or raw seed-level table is supplied.

name: recurrence_specification
description: Algorithm 1 and Appendix B.3 state different Newton–Schulz coefficient forms.

name: architecture_feasibility
description: The paper does not state a complete policy for wide/ rank-deficient matrices, biases, or normalization parameters under the column-orthogonal constraint.

name: IG 视觉语义理解边界
description: The conclusion explicitly says UFEval has relatively limited IG performance and attributes this to insufficient active visual semantic understanding.

name: 标签来源与人类外部效度
description: Most labels are GPT-4o completions; human annotations cover partial FRA-ID/FRA-OOD subsets (6.9K/6.0K). This bounds direct claims about alignment with human judgment.

name: 点式评分与绝对校准
description: FRABench uses pairwise comparisons because prior work is cited for contextual bias in pointwise scores; the design therefore does not test absolute score calibration or reward-scale stability.

name: OOD 范围
description: OOD is defined by ten held-out sub-tasks and selected unseen TAs; it does not establish generalization to arbitrary new tasks, modalities, languages, or aspect definitions.

name: UA 排除 query 的构念边界
description: GPT-4o UA annotation excludes the query to avoid folding response correctness into output-quality judgments, which changes the evaluated construct for query-dependent cases.

name: 人工 taxonomy 与 aspect overlap
description: The taxonomy is manually organized and low correlations are treated as distinctness evidence; no independent taxonomy adjudication or preregistered correlation threshold is supplied.

name: 人类一致性异质性
description: FRA-OOD-H mean alpha is 0.81 but Appeal is 0.60 and several aspects are 0.60--0.69, so reliability is not uniform across criteria.

name: 复现细节缺口
description: Random seeds, number of independent runs, and a complete per-task hyperparameter table are not present in the read version.

name: 下游 DPO 证据范围
description: DPO is demonstrated on one IU backbone and SDXL-Turbo with synthetic/judge-generated preferences; no direct human preference audit or cross-model replication is reported.

name: scope_generality
description: Formal theory is restricted to convex, thrice-differentiable GLM/RERM with separable strongly convex regularizer; non-convex deep models and p≫n are future directions.

name: compute_deployment
description: Full Hessian construction and inversion can be expensive in very high dimensions; approximate second-order methods are not analyzed.

name: distribution_data
description: Theorems use sub-Gaussian features and sub-polylogarithmic responses; real-data evidence has only MNIST and IMDb.

name: multiple_deletion_scaling
description: The theoretical m scaling is looser than the empirical curve; §6 calls matching the empirical m³ behavior future work.

name: calibration_constants
description: C1(n), C2(n) are polylogarithmic and computable in principle; no sharpness is claimed and rigorous plugin calibration is deferred.

name: metric_scope
description: GED/UED are prediction-level criteria; alternative excess-risk criteria and full upstream utility are discussed but not comprehensively evaluated.

name: causal_identification
description: The step-count explanation is supported by theory and baseline curves, but the experiment does not factorially separate certifiability, noise scale and Newton residual.

name: non-uniform target-surface sampling
description: The number of target points associated with each SMPL point varies; sufficient sampling and removing close points mitigate but do not solve it.

name: training-data clothing coverage
description: Body-type diversity is described as reasonable, but styles entirely absent from training data cannot be generated.

name: UV seam artifacts
description: UV discontinuity segmentation can cause seam artifacts; garment-patch-aligned segmentation is proposed for future work.

name: extreme local sparsity
description: Loose clothing/hair extreme cases may exhibit small local sparsity, with Poisson reconstruction shown as a demonstration.

name: mismatched-feature wrinkle naturalness
description: Incompatible feature maps still produce reasonable results, but wrinkle details may not be entirely natural.

name: standard metric for physical plausibility
description: The paper states there is no standard metric and substitutes a user study.

name: scope_iid_single_step
description: The algorithm’s efficient global-resolution route assumes n iid tokens from one draft distribution q and the single-step setting.

name: arbitrary_pdraft_runtime
description: For arbitrary p_draft, max-flow is exact but the network remains enormous; the paper does not claim a generally faster route.

name: early_termination
description: Global resolution can stop when T exceeds fixed limits or L-BFGS-B misses the gradient threshold; large T is usually the failure cause.

name: temperature_and_k
description: High temperature and k>10 increase failure rates; low temperature is the favorable regime.

name: multistep_fallback
description: The SpecTr speedup is conservative because failure falls back to p-sampling with poor acceptance; solver selection is left open.

name: non_iid_n_ge_3
description: For n≥3 independent distinct drafts, computing H* and outer residuals hits a higher-degree submodular-minimization bottleneck.

name: empirical_generality
description: Empirical evidence covers two model pairs, five benchmarks, and CPU-only solver measurements; no broader architecture or deployment sweep is reported.

name: statistical_reporting
description: Averages and success rates are reported without intervals, dispersion, seeds, or formal tests; the paper’s “significant” wording is not accompanied by a test.

name: code_and_ethics
description: The reproducibility statement gives implementation prose but no code URL; no separate ethics or broader-impact discussion appears.

name: h 选择困难
description: 结论承认 appropriate sub-chain length h can be nontrivial；h>2 成本与边际收益见 Table 9。

name: 理论假设边界
description: 依赖 differentiability/bounded gradients、Gaussian noise、L-smooth reward、预算区间和 Vh≪Vz。

name: DCoT 泛化范围
description: 只在 5 个 hand prompt 与 j=30–40 上示范，prompt 由 ChatGPT 生成。

name: 实验不确定性与因果识别

name: 记号与交叉引用可读性

name: single_class_reduction
description: 理论逐类隔离并忽略 class interactions；作者称为 strong assumption。

name: linear_high_dimensional_scope
description: 理论限于 linear、ridgeless/min-norm 和 p,n 同阶。

name: random_matrix_assumptions

name: overparameterized_restriction

name: model_shift_scope

name: representation_and_pca

name: fixed_test_distribution
description: test与real training同分布；没有 OOD 主实验。

name: limited_empirical_coverage
description: 视觉任务、一个文本任务和固定模型组合，外推范围有限。

name: hardware_and_cost

name: wall_clock_measurement
description: 未见端到端 wall-clock latency、吞吐或真实部署功耗；效率结论依赖 sequence/token accounting。

name: seed_and_denominator_reporting
description: 未报告具体 seed、任务样本数和指标分母，限制了外部复核的统计粒度。

name: Adapter-style architecture scope
description: Findings may not generalize to discrete visual tokenization or end-to-end joint vision-language training, where language-only priors are harder to isolate.

name: Safety and ethics untested
description: Capability experiments do not audit societal bias, stereotypes, harmful visual associations, fairness or safety.

name: Static-image scope
description: Video and dynamic modalities are left open; temporal reasoning, action recognition and causal structure may draw from different text sources.

name: Perception/reasoning boundary
description: The authors call the perception-heavy/reasoning-heavy split a conceptual simplification and say the boundary is not always clear.

name: Alignment interpretation
description: Figure 11 is non-monotonic; the paper offers vocabulary scarcity as a possible explanation and leaves structure/grounding interplay open.

name: Blind shortcut risk
description: Blind tuning improves tabled scores but the paper says it should remain optional because absent-image hallucination can increase.

name: Solver/variant coverage
description: 作者在结论明确表示 L2Seg 不保证提升所有 VRP solvers/variants；VRPB 与 1-VRPPD 只有聚合规则和证明，没有结果表。
evidence_sections: 6 Conclusion|B.1.5 Applying FSTA on Various VRPs

name: Backbone interface
description: 实际加速要求 solver 接受 warm start；dual hypernode 还要求 fixed-edge local search，HGS 接口扩展留作未来工作。

name: Lookahead/label dependence
description: 训练标签来自特定 lookahead solver invocation；Table 5 显示 solver-dependent pattern，因此换 solver 可能改变标签分布。

name: Synthetic-to-real breadth
description: 主实验以 uniform synthetic CVRP/VRPTW 为主，realistic CVRPLib、clustered 和 heterogeneous-demand 结果在附录扩展；未覆盖所有应用分布。
evidence_sections: 5 Experiment / Data Distribution|E.2 Results on Realistic Routing Datasets

name: Inference overhead
description: SYN-LNS overhead 在表中达到 CVRP5k 9.4%、VRPTW5k 9.6%；调用频率是可调参数但代价—质量关系未展开。
evidence_sections: Table 15|E.7 The Neural Network Overheads of L2Seg

name: Training cost
description: CVRP5k 并行训练合计约 59.9h；10k 约 6 天是作者 projection，环境影响只作定性讨论。

name: Uncertainty reporting
description: 主表和主文 ablation 没有 error bars 或显著性检验，5-trial standard deviation 仅在附录 Table 13。

name: Objective of single/dual choice
description: single aggregation 的 asymmetric transformation 与 fixed direction 可能缩小搜索空间，dual 的 fixed edge 增加实现复杂度；选择依 backbone。

name: standalone limitations section
description: 没有名为 Limitations 的正文或附录章节；摘要、引言、结论也未列 limitation。

name: early timestep assignment instability
description: A.7 称少数情况下前 1–3 timesteps 的 clusters 可较不稳定，并以先 fully compute 三步作为缓解。

name: LoRA coverage boundary
description: 作者说不能 exhaustively test all possible LoRA adapters；drastic adapter changes 可能需要 re-clustering。

name: single-seed statistical scope
description: reproducibility statement 指定 seed=0；Tables 1–5 没有 across-seed uncertainty or tests。

name: hardware and latency protocol
description: 报告 latency/FLOPs，但 A.1 未列硬件、batch 或计时方法。

name: non-RK cache-only solver derivations
description: A.2.2 给 generic BDF/AM/TF formulas；A.6 只把 RK2 写成 cached feature recurrence。

name: dedicated limitations section
description: 正文和附录没有独立 limitations 标题；限制信息分散在引言、setup、结果和附录。

name: compute boundary
description: 16K training、128K inference 与 16×A100/8×MI300X 构成工程边界；成本没有数值化。

name: data dependence
description: 三种多跳 QA、Book RULER、math；难度用 Qwen2.5-32B 八次 pass rate 筛选，样本分布依赖该模型。
evidence_sections: 3.1 Seed Dataset Curation and Context Extension

name: metric boundary
description: binary substring reward 只验证 boxed final answer，没有 trajectory correctness 或 verifier 独立 precision/recall。

name: generality boundary
description: 训练模型只有 Qwen2.5-7B/14B；外部 frontier 对照不是同 recipe 的 scale study。

name: causal identification
description: pattern 归因依赖 KeyChain replacement、少量轨迹和 checkpoint 手工检查，没有链长/干扰密度随机化或行为标注干预。

name: deployment boundary
description: 没有真实法律文档、代码库、在线延迟或部署成本评测。

name: Fine-tuning compute cost
description: §6 explicitly says compiler/executor interaction makes RL-based optimization computationally expensive; A.16 attributes 35% of 120 hours to RL execution.

name: Reuse-dependent deployment fit
description: §6 says code-generation and execution time both matter and the method is particularly suited to repeatedly reused sparse code; A.17/Table 19 gives limited examples.

name: Other-backend scope
description: §6 defers other hardware-backends to A.18; A.18 offers HIP/data/reward adaptation steps without experimental backend results.

name: Extreme irregular matrix failures
description: A.15 reports va2010 and az2010 where cuSPARSE GFLOPS exceeds SparseRL, attributed to row imbalance or strided accesses.

name: Dataset scale and generalization
description: A.21 recognizes the 1100-entity RL dataset as relatively modest and says larger 5k–10k data could improve unseen/edge-case generalization.

name: Experimental-protocol under-specification
description: After full-paper reading, seeds, repeated training, compiler flags, timing warm-up, test oracles and box-plot definitions remain absent; this is an evidence limitation rather than an author-labeled limitation.

name: explicit limitations section
description: The paper transitions from §4 Related Work to §5 Conclusion and has no heading named Limitations.

name: training_and_test_distribution
description: Training is dominated by synthetic HotpotQA-style QA plus DocQA-RL-1.6K; tests are QA, NIAH and two summary datasets, not code/table/vision/multilingual or interactive deployment.

name: length_scope
description: The prose says unlimited/arbitrary, but direct RULER reaches 3.5M and NIAH reaches 512K; longer scale is only an estimator.

name: fixed_memory_failures
description: Appendix F shows irreversible overwrite, missing prerequisite and primacy-bias errors; their denominator is not folded into the main aggregate tables.

name: experimental_uncertainty
description: No seeds, repeats, error bars, intervals, tests or per-benchmark sample counts are reported for the point estimates.

name: system_cost
description: FLOP estimates omit actual hardware, latency, memory, throughput, parallelism and failed-call behavior.

name: artifact_availability
description: The reproducibility statement says code, dataset and weights will be available; the PDF itself supplies prompt/config details but not a complete downloadable implementation.

name: complexity_to_quality_identification
description: Fixed C+M supports the O(N) FLOP argument, but quality still depends on the learned write policy and truncation; FLOPs alone do not prove lossless memory.

name: compute
description: Video diffusion adds computational overhead and may limit real-time use.

name: extreme_lighting
description: Insufficient illumination over large regions under extreme lighting degrades shading and normal reliability.

name: transparent_materials
description: High-quality normal maps are not produced for transparent or semi-transparent objects.

name: scope
description: Evaluation is primarily object-centric; scene-centric extension is future work.

name: statistical_reporting
description: No uncertainty, repeated-seed spread, significance test, or confidence interval appears with the reported means and ablations.

name: reproducibility
description: Several implementation details and benchmark indices are delegated to an appendix absent from the PDF.

name: No fine-tuning comparison
description: The approach focuses on training-free extension, limiting direct comparison with extension methods evaluated with fine-tuning.

name: RoPE-specific generality
description: The radix-transformation framework is tied to RoPE; extension to T5 relative bias and ALiBi is left open.

name: Incomplete reporting of randomness and uncertainty
description: The PDF reports selected random samples but no seed count, repetitions, variability, or inferential procedure.

name: Supplementary source access
description: The paper says code was submitted as supplementary materials, but that file is absent from the assigned corpus.

name: preference_oracle_ceiling
description: preference oracle fidelity acts as a performance ceiling; high-quality generations become harder to distinguish.

name: binary_signal_diminishing_returns
description: chosen/rejected responses becoming high quality makes binary preference signals less informative and can slow or stall learning.

name: homogeneous_theory_scope
description: formal analysis assumes shared preference oracle and constant-sum structure; HT-MNPO lacks formal convergence guarantees.

name: alternative_equilibrium_future_work
description: paper names coarse correlated equilibrium or alternative game structures as future theoretical routes.

name: compute_cost_quantification
description: 8 H100 hardware is stated, but no compute-cost comparison across n, iterations, or variants is reported.

name: human_annotator_evaluation
description: Abstract invokes heterogeneous annotator conditions, but experiments use reward models and LLM judges rather than a reported human-annotator study.

name: ethics_or_deployment_analysis
description: No standalone ethics, deployment, or broader-impact discussion is present in main text or appendix headings.

name: local_optimality_and_regularness
description: Formal results assume a population minimizer, common support, dominated convergence, local Lipschitz maps, and a small base-model error in Hd geometry.

name: directional_curvature
description: The clean weight window uses local PSD curvature; the weaker alternative is only directional smoothness along the Neon ray.

name: A_MONO_for_continuous_models
description: Diffusion/flow mode-seeking requires curvature–density coupling; the finite-step bias vanishes as h→0.

name: diversity_seeking_boundary
description: High-temperature or anti-mode samplers can make s>0; then interpolation with -1<w<0 is prescribed.

name: finite_set_and_short_ft_tradeoff
description: Small |S| is variance-limited, large |S| can amplify curvature, and αT must remain small.

name: empirical_scope
description: The main empirical coverage is four model families, three datasets, public checkpoints, and selected resolutions.

name: metric_scope
description: FID and P/R are the principal metrics; no human, semantic, or class-conditional quality evaluation is reported.

name: uncertainty_and_selection
description: No seed-level spread, intervals, tests, held-out selection, hardware, or wall-clock accounting is provided.

name: ethics_scope
description: Ethics Statement limits itself to public standard datasets, no private/identifying data, and possible misuse.

name: High-dimensional latent artifacts
description: Moving from 4-channel to 16-channel VAE latents causes occasional bottom noise, solid-color, noisy-image, and grid artifacts.

name: Artifact causes unresolved
description: The paper labels numerical instability, under-convergence, and 1D positional encoding as plausible factors and says the underlying causes remain open.

name: Inference latency
description: Serial LLM decoding is dominant and multi-step FM sampling is material; proposed acceleration directions are future work.

name: High-resolution scaling
description: Sequential generation needs substantially more training steps at higher resolution and diffusion timestep-shift techniques do not transfer directly.

name: SFT data scale and stability
description: Small high-quality SFT datasets can yield marginal gains or abrupt overfitting; substantial improvement requires million-sample scale.

name: Statistical transparency
description: No seeds, repetitions, denominators, intervals, significance tests, or human evaluation protocol are reported for the main benchmark comparisons.

name: Training-data and reproducibility scope
description: The pipeline includes very large, proprietary and in-house sources; the PDF does not give complete licenses, filtering thresholds, training hardware, or wall-clock time.

name: Evaluation and model-variant scope
description: Editing uses a fine-tuned variant, raw and rewrite/Self-CoT protocols differ, and Table 3 labels the final row NextStep-1 although the text names NextStep-1-Edit.

name: single_delegate
description: Main construction assumes one reliable delegate client; removing it is only sketched.

name: no_delegate_bound
description: Suggested no-delegate variant uses R-CSS and Delta_max; its convergence/complexity is not proved in this paper.

name: multiple_delegates
description: More than one delegate may improve current complexity, but the question is left open.

name: SAG_scope
description: SAG cannot inherit the same delta-only worst-case variance bound as SAGA; empirical performance can still be good.

name: oracle_scope
description: Main analysis assumes deterministic first-order local oracle; stochastic, zero-order and higher-order cases are future work.

name: payload_scope
description: The model does not constrain information size; compression is future work.

name: ethics_statement
description: Ethics statement is generic and does not highlight a specific societal consequence.

name: dedicated_limitations_section
description: The PDF has no dedicated Limitations section; Section 6 ends the main text.

name: pinhole_camera_assumption
description: Appendix A assumes an ideal pinhole camera and ignores lens distortion and skew.

name: fronto_parallel_scope
description: Eq. (6) is derived for a fronto-parallel segment; general shapes need not have pixel-wise equality under the same transforms.

name: known_intrinsics_dependency
description: Ray conditioning requires intrinsics; UniDepth v2 is used to estimate them when unavailable.

name: synthetic_camera_proxy
description: Quantitative cross-camera tests use resize/crop perturbations; physical unseen-camera evidence is qualitative TUM-RGBD.

name: reproducibility_detail_gap
description: Seeds, sample counts, sampling ratios, full splits, loss details, and leakage controls are not stated.

name: uncertainty_reporting_gap
description: No error bars, intervals, tests, or seed variance appear in the result objects.

name: homogeneous_graph_scope
description: Current datasets primarily consist of homogeneous graphs; heterogeneous node/edge types are future work.

name: task_scope
description: Current comparison is graph classification; few-shot, dynamic graph and anomaly detection tasks are future work.

name: theory_boundary
description: The Information Bottleneck section derives an objective, KL surrogate and update rule, but gives no convergence, generalization or guaranteed tail-benefit theorem.

name: metric_boundary
description: No direct per-prototype hit-uniformity diagnostic, per-tail influence measurement or formal performance guarantee is reported.

name: reproducibility_boundary
description: The PDF states that code is at an anonymous link and gives 20 repeats, but omits seed values and a public URL.

name: ethics_scope
description: The work uses graph learning without individual-level sensitive data or direct user interaction; downstream sensitive deployment is left to practitioners to assess.

name: small-τ information limit
description: InstUtil Rank lower bound covers τ≤0.1；AvgUtil full-information covers τ=O(1/(T log T))；AvgUtil bandit covers τ=O(1/log T)。

name: InstUtil variation requirement
description: Algorithm 2 的 positive bound 依赖 P(T)=O(T^q), q<1；τ 也需固定为 positive constant 才能避免 estimator bound 发散。
evidence_sections: §4 Hardness Results|§5.2 Sublinear Regret with InstUtil Rank

name: AvgUtil bandit unresolved regime
description: Theorem 6.3 只覆盖 q<1/3 且 stable oracle；作者将 constant τ 下移除 Assumption 4.2 留作 future work。
evidence_sections: §6.3 Bandit Setting|Appendix M Conclusion and Limitations

name: oracle and variation assumptions
description: AvgUtil full/bandit 依赖 Assumption 6.1，game CCE 还依赖 Assumption 7.1；FTRL 的满足性通过 Lemma L.3 证明。

name: simulated-only evidence
description: 实验为 hypothetical/simulated，LLM routing 只验证一个 reward-model 驱动的模拟任务。

name: real preference/deployment boundary
description: 没有真实人类 ranking、ride-sharing/match-dating deployment 或公平性测试；Ethics 只讨论潜在 misuse。
evidence_sections: §9 Ethics Statement|Appendix M Conclusion and Limitations

name: reproducibility detail gap
description: 正文未提供代码仓库、硬件、软件版本、完整 prompt/response 生成细节或原始 seeds 的执行产物；Reproducibility Statement 仅指向 assumptions 与 proofs。

name: reinforcement_learning_scope
description: 未研究 RL dataset 或 RL training，研究范围限于 SFT data curation。

name: staged_sft_and_curriculum_scope
description: 未研究 staged SFT 或 curriculum learning。

name: sequential_selection_scope
description: 各阶段依据前一阶段 ranking 选择 winner，后续差异是条件化比较；science 的最终 teacher curve 受跨域 average 选择影响。

name: evaluation_scope
description: 主 pipeline 只用八个任务，held-out 只有四个任务；MATH500 单 pass，其余 benchmark 重复次数不同。

name: seed_and_retain_rate_scope
description: 没有公开每次训练随机 seed、逐题过滤保留率、样本重叠或完整 1,000+ 实验日志。

name: compute_and_api_scope
description: QwQ annotation 与 OpenThinker training 需要大规模 GPU，pipeline ablations 还依赖外部 API cost。

name: safety_scope
description: OpenThinker3 没有 safety tuning，Harmbench harmfulness 高于 Qwen base；论文把 safety-specific data 留作 future work。
evidence_sections: I Safety Analysis of OpenThinker Models|I Safety Analysis of OpenThinker Models

name: web_trace_scope
description: 从 DCLM-RefinedWeb 找到的高相似文本没有呈现现代 reasoning trace，web sourcing 不能替代 teacher annotation。
evidence_sections: M Sourcing reasoning traces from the Web

name: A1 perfect USF and A2 linear reward are theorem assumptions
description: The empirical setting violates both assumptions; A.5 adds mismatch terms but does not restore the clean bound.

name: A3 exact optimization oracle
description: The regret theorem assumes exact Eq.10 optimization while practice uses approximate random shooting.

name: Episode-level guarantee versus per-step practice
description: Formal proof freezes task embeddings within each episode; per-step updates are empirically faster.

name: Finite/infinite horizon mismatch
description: Analysis uses finite-horizon SF while empirical evaluation instantiates an infinite-horizon form; only an l2 truncation error expression is given.

name: Unknown structure of Z
description: The conclusion says the feature/task embedding space structure is not formally or practically understood.

name: Narrow empirical scope
description: Main evaluation is three DMC locomotion environments; OGBench requires task and reward-radius modifications.

name: Unreported deployment/ethics measurements
description: No human evaluation, real-pixel deployment, memory/energy accounting or ethics/impact section appears in the 34-page PDF.

name: no standalone limitations section
description: The main paper moves from experiments to conclusion without a titled limitations section.

name: EAGLE-3 identifiability caveat
description: Top-K drafting sets all draft probabilities to 1; BE gain may be stochasticity/precision rather than verifier mathematics.

name: multi-draft baseline scope
description: Blockwise is omitted from multi-draft because extension is described as not straightforward.

name: implementation scope
description: Listing 2 assumes batch_size=1 in the current implementation.

name: evaluation scope
description: Main experiments cover three tasks and a limited set of model/framework configurations; LLaMA extension uses GSM8K.

name: uncertainty reporting
description: Main Tables 1–4 give point values; five-seed mean ± standard deviation is moved to Tables A.1 and A.3.

name: pstar_scope
description: Main analytic/results presentation uses p*=1; p*=2 appears in Appendix D.

name: limit_order
description: The p to infinity limit is after N to infinity with p much smaller than N.

name: finite_size_identification
description: Discontinuous finite-N behavior is explained with logarithmic edge sampling and alpha_0, but the extrapolation is called a conjecture/estimate.
evidence_sections: 4.2 Numerical Simulations and Finite N BBP Transition|4.2 Numerical Simulations and Finite N BBP Transition

name: threshold_state_dynamics
description: The BBP transition of threshold states and its relation to gradient flow remain uncharacterized.

name: general_activation_scope
description: Arbitrary activation receives a Hessian form and two activation plots, not a repeated field-theory derivation.

name: tanh_denominator
description: Because tanh can approach a negative denominator singularity, the authors set a=50 so the loss is effectively MSE.

name: reproducibility_metadata
description: Seeds, code, hardware, most hyperparameters, run counts apart from Figure 8, and error-bar definitions are not present.

name: data_and_baseline_scope
description: No real dataset, held-out benchmark, human evaluation or external baseline is used; all evidence is synthetic teacher-student/spectral or preliminary dynamics.
evidence_sections: 2 The Model|4.2 Numerical Simulations and Finite N BBP Transition

name: Newton convergence
description: General convergence in L Newton steps is cited as impractical; the useful regime needs O(1) iterations. Three iterations are reported only for the two cells in this work and must be checked for new cells.

name: dense-Jacobian cost
description: Naïve dense Jacobians would require O(L d_h^2) memory and O(d_h^3) pairwise multiplication, motivating structured Jacobians.

name: diagonal expressivity trade-off
description: Setting A_* and C_* diagonal inhibits hidden-state component mixing and effectively yields independent one-dimensional cells; A5 exposes the resulting weakness.

name: structured-kernel scope
description: Other Jacobian structures can be represented in principle, but the provided CUDA reduction requires one full equation to fit in thread registers; dense structures need an alternative.

name: ParaLSTM runtime overhead
description: The block-diagonal LSTM solver is slower than the diagonal GRU solver in the reported Mamba comparisons because it is more memory- and computation-intensive.

name: experimental scope
description: Language-model evidence covers two adapted cells, one SlimPajama-derived training flow, four scales, and the reported A100/H100 setups.

name: theoretical fast-convergence gap
description: The authors say a comprehensive theory of cell conditions for fast convergence is beyond scope and leave it for future research.

name: High-dimensional MORL
description: 约 10,000 维连续 MORL 上，直接对 parameter space 使用 MLP denoiser 受限；作者建议 Latent Diffusion 或 Transformer。

name: Categorical MONAS
description: 纯 categorical search space 对 continuous diffusion 构成困难；作者提出 continuous-space categorical diffusion 或 fully discrete guidance 作为后续方向。

name: Combinatorial scope
description: TSP、CVRP 等组合任务当前排除，permutation constraints 只在未来 constrained diffusion 方案中讨论。

name: Data-quality-sensitive reweighting
description: ZDT2 的长尾 dominance distribution 让大量样本获近零权重，可能损失 manifold signal；τ 调整可缓解但任务依赖。

name: Dominance preprocessing cost
description: dominance number 的朴素计算为 O(N²m)；RE34 的 60,000 点实测约 17.3 sec，但超大数据集仍可能受限。

name: Far extrapolation
description: 增加 extrapolation distance 的收益递减，MO-Hopper run-to-run variance 增加；作者把远离训练分布的模型不确定性作为解释。
evidence_sections: A.6.2 Noise Scale and Extrapolation Distance

name: Misuse and training-data bias
description: Ethics Statement 承认潜在 misuse、training-data bias amplification，并要求 oversight、safeguards、careful dataset curation。

name: Missing formal guarantee/deployment validation
description: 正文给出 definitions 与 numbered diffusion/reweighting equations，但没有 theorem/proof、真实部署、用户评测或超出 benchmark oracle 的安全验证。

name: Parameter increase at context 1024
description: Models need a slight parameter increase to match the MDLM baseline at context 1024; authors attribute it to GroupSwap.

name: Training compute overhead
description: PGM training is slightly more expensive because dense torch.sdpa masks are used; Table 3 demonstrates lower OWT training throughput.

name: Sparse-kernel gap
description: The paper has no block-diagonal sparse kernel and leaves such efficient kernels to future work.

name: Domain generality
description: Multimodal application remains open; experiments cover text and ImageNet only.

name: Long-context training
description: Models above context 1024 were not trained due to compute cost; only inference timing at 4096 is given.

name: Training stability
description: Complementary masking produces occasional loss spikes; larger-scale impact is not tested.

name: Gradient-variance mechanism
description: Variance reduction is asserted and PPL is measured, but a gradient-variance statistic is absent.

name: Quality uncertainty reporting
description: No seed-level or image/text-quality uncertainty is reported despite batch-level timing SD.

name: Internal LM1B PPL inconsistency
description: The 1.95 PPL statement assigned to PGM disagrees with the PGM/MDLM table values.

name: semantic_sensitivity
description: State-action discriminator confidence may miss repeated sensitive locations and long-horizon sequence patterns; the authors suggest location-specific and long-term signals such as hospital risk.

name: trusted_server_central_variant
description: Central aggregation assumes a trustworthy server that can access raw rewards; LDP is proposed to relax this assumption.

name: baseline_fairness
description: Centralized non-federated non-DP baselines are not a strict apples-to-apples comparison with federated DP methods.

name: data_scope
description: Utility and MIA evidence covers Geolife and Telecom Shanghai; no broader mobility distributions are tested.

name: external_semantic_cues
description: Location types or home-work labels are excluded from sensitivity because the paper says they would depend on non-private information.

name: missing_downstream_and_scalability_measurement
description: Abstract claims downstream performance and scalability, but the evaluation contains no downstream task or runtime/scaling measurement.

name: exact greedy correction training cost
description: Cor.A.9 exact path 需要多次 denoiser evaluation；softmax correction 复杂，PAPL detach 规避。

name: P2 full-support ELBO
description: regularized P2-TopK 需枚举 subset，成本迅速 computationally prohibitive；实践采用近似。
evidence_sections: A.4.2 Markov Chain Setup and ELBO for P2 Planner

name: pure PAPL instability
description: Fig.5 显示 loss fluctuation 和 validation convergence 差，作者以 confidence over-concentration 解释。
evidence_sections: C.1 Unstable Training with Pure PAPL Loss

name: high α and OOD
description: α 过高可能学习窄路径并影响 OOD planner confidence；D guide 建议从 α=1 开始。

name: protein functional proxy
description: foldability 由 ESMFold pLDDT/pTM/pAE composite criterion 代理；无 biological synthesis/wet-lab。

name: text metric risks
description: MAUVE 依赖 external LM embedding；Gen PPL 只看生成文本并可被 overconfident schedule 操纵。

name: code failure scope
description: C.4 仅评估 40 HumanEval tasks，展示多步逻辑、约束处理与 catastrophic failures。
evidence_sections: C.4 HumanEval Performance Analysis|C.4 HumanEval Performance Analysis

name: uncertainty reporting
description: 表 1–4、Fig.3–4 未给 CI、seed spread、显著性或 bootstrap。

name: two-stage sequencing
description: Concept learning must precede providing conceptual self-supervision to the continual-learning task; the paper identifies end-to-end integration as future work.

name: interaction with other logit regularizers
description: The paper leaves the joint effect with regularization methods that also manipulate logits for future study.

name: attribute-shifting substitutivity
description: Appendix H.1 reports no significant improvement for substitutivity and connects it to ViT feature extractors handling color or other attribute shifts.

name: concept-sharing dependence on data
description: The authors argue concept sharing is common in complex real-world and fine-grained datasets, while Figure 8 describes sharing as visually rare between CIFAR100 classes.

name: comparison fairness
description: Table 10 uses CLIP ViT-B/16 for CompSLOT and compares against values described as top performance from original papers; Appendix B says perfect fairness is impossible because CLG-CBM uses external LLMs.

name: statistical reporting detail
description: Trials and 95% confidence intervals are named, but seed values, interval construction, formal tests and multiple-comparison handling are absent from the PDF.

name: scaling and deployment evidence
description: Efficiency is quantified for one FOSTER/CGQA example and a parameter-count plot; no general scaling law or deployment measurement is provided.

name: premise retrieval ceiling
description: Ground truth outperforms all selectors in Tables 2–3, so some failures arise because necessary lemmas are not retrieved.

name: Lean-auto translation scope
description: Dependent-type-theory features may be out of scope for translation to higher-order logic.

name: unsupported proof reasoning
description: Induction and arithmetic are given as examples of reasoning unsupported by Aesop, Zipperposition, or Duper.

name: proof reconstruction
description: Zipperposition success followed by Duper reconstruction failure is reported as rare, not impossible.

name: training compute
description: Training the large selector costs 6.5 A6000-days.

name: benchmark and deployment coverage
description: Empirical coverage is Mathlib hold-out plus six miniCTX-v2-test splits; no user study or broader IDE adoption evaluation appears.

name: seed, uncertainty, and leakage audit
description: The PDF does not report seeds, repeated-run uncertainty, inferential tests, intervals, or a train/test leakage audit.

name: independent limitations section
description: There is no heading named Limitations; boundaries are embedded in §4.1, §4.2, and the Table 4 explanation.

name: prior_asymptotic_assumption
description: Lemma 1.3 and dependent prior analyses assume m tends to infinity; the paper replaces this relationship but does not test every finite-m regime.

name: theory_domain
description: Guarantees require d≥3 and ψ∈(0,π/2); boundary φ∈{0,π} or ψ∈{0,π} is treated as trivial/fixed.

name: configuration_optimum
description: General best covering configurations remain open; Algorithms 1/2 are constructions rather than a general optimum.

name: compute_tradeoff
description: L decreases reference angle but raises index size and testing time; KS2 fixes m=256 for byte IDs.

name: dataset_and_hardware_scope
description: Evaluation is on six datasets and one CPU setup; no GPU/distributed/online-update evidence is provided.

name: connectivity_exception
description: Word high-recall behavior is attributed to HNSW connectivity, where ScaNN can outperform HNSW+KS2.

name: nssg_exception
description: NSSG+KS2 does not beat NSSG+PEOs on GIST.

name: statistics_reporting
description: No uncertainty, seed, raw curve values or significance tests are reported; Table 1 only states ten-run averages.

name: dedicated_limitations_section
description: There is no section titled Limitations; constraints are distributed across remarks, results and appendix.

name: standalone_limitations_section
description: 论文没有独立的 Limitations 标题；限制分散在方法、结果、结论和 Appendix G。

name: reward_scope
description: 所有报告实验使用 support-fact terminal reward；LLM-based answer reward 留作 future work。

name: baseline_heterogeneity
description: 基线分为 reported、reproduced、ablation，训练资源和 benchmark setting 并不统一。

name: missing_subtask_breakdowns
description: Titans 和 Atlas 没有 Figure 2b 所需的 QA3 breakdown，因此未纳入该图。

name: missing_uncertainty
description: 除 Table 3 的未定义 ± 外，主结果没有误差表达、样本分母或统计检验。
evidence_sections: §4.3 Needle-in-a-Haystack and Long Context QA|§5 Ablation Study

name: temporal_mechanism_identification
description: relative positional encoding 有 QA3 语义动机，但没有独立 ablation 或替代 positional encoding 对照。
evidence_sections: §3.3 Temporal Reasoning for Long-Context Search|§5 Ablation Study

name: metric_scope
description: Fact EM 使用集合包含关系，额外 irrelevant chunks 不扣满分；Fact F1 才反映 noise。

name: theory_scope
description: Theorem 2 直接给 L2 error rate；uniform L∞ 需要额外 regularity 或较慢 rate。

name: structural_assumptions
description: limit transformer 需要 Δ-periodic positional embeddings、translation-invariant φ 与 τ-locality。

name: depth_and_precision_scope
description: Theorem 4.1 只覆盖 single-layer finite precision；Theorem 5.2 只覆盖 restricted depth-2 infinite precision Fτ。

name: average_case_distribution
description: Theorem 4.2 依赖 iid categorical sequence 与 Dirichlet prior；更广分布被列为 future work。

name: weight_and_margin_cost
description: 两层 complexity 对第一层 weight norms 指数增长，inverse positional/logit margin 也放大训练长度。

name: synthetic_qualitative_evidence
description: 实验只覆盖三类 synthetic tasks，作者称结果为 qualitative support；没有真实 LLM 或 tightness 检验。

name: future_extensions
description: 更大 depth、C-RASP complexity、broader distributions、position encoding effects 未处理。

name: ethics_and_llm_usage
description: Ethics 为通用声明；LLM Usage 仅说明用于 grammar checking。

name: no dedicated limitations section
description: §5 Conclusion 后直接进入 Acknowledgments、Ethics、Reproducibility；限制分散在方法假设、脚注和 Appendix G。

name: non-compact translation and degenerate set
description: T(3) 非 compact，论文以 CoM-free subspace 固定平移并移除 SO(3) action 不 free 的 measure-zero set D。

name: near-collinear numerical conditioning
description: K−1 对 near-collinear point systems 可能数值敏感；实现加入 εI，典型 ε=1e−8。

name: scope beyond SE(3)
description: U(1)、SU(2) 和更高 representation 被列为可能扩展，但未在本文实验。

name: reward-guided transition probability
description: projected one-step density 在 total space 不具有 Lebesgue absolute continuity，应在当前 subspace 定义；reward tilting 留作 extension。

name: metric and benchmark coverage
description: 主文省略 diversity/novelty，原因是旧 FoldSeek alntmscore bug；完整比较限定为 v10 对 small Proteína 与 quotient counterpart。

name: reproduction pipeline mismatch
description: GEOM reproduction 依照 released configurations，但 data-processing pipeline 变化使结果与原 ET-Flow paper 不完全相同。

name: seed/repeat and causal attribution gap
description: 未报告 seed、独立 repeats 或不确定性；也没有 P/h̃ 的 component ablation，因此跨设置改善的方差和各组件因果贡献仍不可估计。

name: domain_scope
description: 作者明示当前范围有限，尚未覆盖 electromagnetics、structural mechanics 或 aerodynamics。

name: combustion_metric
description: 作者明示没有专门针对 Combustion 的 physics-oriented metric。

name: ood_coverage
description: 作者明示当前没有系统探索 strong out-of-distribution regimes。

name: safety_validation
description: Ethics Statement 要求 safety-critical use 前进一步 validation。

name: protocol_reporting
description: 读者核对发现 PDF 没有报告每个数据集实际 n／train ratio、seed、hardware、update budget、完整 config 和 noise／mask 选值；这些仅以接口或外部 code availability 形式出现。

name: dataset_count_reporting
description: 采样率、最终 frame count 与部分参数网格的关系未完全解释，影响独立复现实验边界。
evidence_sections: Table 7|B.2 Data Collection|B.3 Details of Data Measurement

name: unobservable_btr_onset
description: 真实 BTR onset、LLM internal belief、threshold U 与 mθ/c0/B̄ 不可直接测量；T3 只能用 observable proxy。

name: strong_theory_assumptions
description: 理论需要 oracle convergence、observation lower bound、policy Lipschitz、update-error growth、value calibration 与 BTR belief-drop 等假设。
evidence_sections: B.2 Dynamics of Belief Trapping|B.4 Detailed Statement of Theorem 2

name: ground_truth_training_proxy
description: PE/MR 主 proxy 访问 v⋆；ground-truth-free 变体只在 PE 上试验。

name: task_specific_generalization
description: H/d 构造依赖任务结构；semantic/internal-state general-purpose detectors只在 preliminary future-work exploration。
evidence_sections: 2.2 From Theory to Practice: Proxy Signals|E.1 More General-Purpose Proxy Design

name: false_positive_cost
description: 过早截断会删除正 future TD-error 和 informative exploratory actions。

name: architecture_heterogeneity
description: 3B 与 LLaMA-8B 收益有限/异质，mθ 解释仍是 conjecture。
evidence_sections: 3.3.4 Impact of LLM Architecture|3.3.4 Impact of LLM Architecture

name: task_horizon_and_terminal_reward
description: 只测五项任务和有限 max turns，且 reward 仅 terminal step；开放域、超长 horizon 和 dense reward 未覆盖。

name: statistical_reporting
description: 未报告 random seeds、run count、error bars、置信区间或显著性，因此 stability/consistency 为描述性结论。

name: missing_predictive_checks
description: Prior-predictive and posterior-predictive checks are absent because they often require manual, domain-specific judgment.

name: partial_adequacy
description: Reliability is based on a subset of available diagnostics, so reported ELPD only partially reflects model adequacy in some cases.

name: no_global_optimum_guarantee
description: The practical refinement strategy has no guarantee of convergence to a globally optimal program.

name: search_and_numerical_failures
description: The model can repeat deprecated fragments, encounter overflow/NaN or initialization errors, hallucinate APIs, exhaust budgets, or produce indentation/commenting failures.

name: cost_and_scope
description: The evaluation spans five datasets and selected PyMC/NumPyro settings; average token ratio is 1.9x baseline and wall-clock/dollar cost is not reported.

name: Offline 评测边界
description: monitor 检查完整 trajectory；latency per step、control logic、blocking vs warning 等 online 约束留待未来。

name: Threat model 不完整
description: prompting 诱发 hijacking 等行为，不能覆盖 adversarial finetuning 或 pretraining-misaligned agents 的 novel evasions。

name: Benchmark 难度与生态
description: CUA-SHADE-Arena 平均约 10k tokens，短于 SHADE-Arena 约 25k；需要真实应用与更丰富 VM。

name: Human overseer 泛化
description: HiTL 只带来 modest gains；generalist overseers 可能低于 LLM，需更好的界面、scaffolding 和 bias/false-positive 控制。

name: 攻击策略覆盖
description: random action injection 和 steganographic CoT encoding 未直接测试，策略集合是代表性子集。

name: 计算与部署代价
description: hierarchical/sequential/hybrid latency 高于 baseline；Table 1 成本和 latency 受 token、硬件、API 影响且标为 placeholder。

name: 版本漂移
description: 作者提示后续 API 更新可能改变结果；完整 model version strings 仅在 Appendix N。

name: 统计报告缺口
description: 正文给柱状图误差条、Figure 6 的 ± 与 capability fitted lines，但未定义误差量或给出显著性/相关系数。

name: No dedicated limitations section
description: 正文没有名为 Limitations 的章节；Section 6 是 Future Directions。

name: Text/code scope
description: 主评测是 text/code retrieval；multimodality 只在 Future Directions 提及。

name: V-normalization domain dependence
description: Wikipedia 与 code 使用不同 architecture variant，统一最优性未建立。

name: No run-level uncertainty
description: 主表、附录表和图不提供 seed、误差范围或显著性检验。

name: Approximate efficiency evidence
description: C.7 只有复杂度阶数，缺少 wall-clock、memory、throughput。

name: Finite scaling grid
description: batch size 仅 4/8/16，LM size 仅 0.135B/0.5B/1B 组合；更大范围未测。

name: Task/domain generality
description: 跨域证据仅来自 Wikipedia、code、Fineweb-edu 和三个 benchmark family，不能直接外推到多模态。

name: dedicated_limitations_section
description: No independent Limitations heading or section appears before References; boundaries are scattered through methods and appendix.

name: long_video_scope
description: One-minute support is shown qualitatively, while VBench-Long aggregates only 30-second videos.

name: data_scope
description: The filtered corpus includes internal data and source-specific motion/saturation thresholds; exact source counts and thresholds are not supplied.
evidence_sections: Appendix C.2|Appendix E Motion Filtering|Appendix E Saturation

name: motion_generality
description: The pipeline removes too-fast and too-slow clips and keeps moderate, clear motion, so the reported distribution excludes extremes.

name: clean_reconstruction_tradeoff
description: DCAE-V has lower clean PSNR/SSIM than Wan2.2-VAE despite its larger compression ratio.

name: metric_scope
description: VBench and latency are reported as point estimates without seed-level distributions or inferential testing.

name: deployment_scope
description: Quantization is tested on one RTX 5090 with selected layers; other edge devices and precision settings are not evaluated.

name: world_model_scope
description: World-model claims are qualitative visualizations after task-specific fine-tuning, without control or simulation metrics.

name: RACG component dependence
description: BM25, syntax-aware chunking and dense reranking can degrade on extremely large, poorly structured or domain-specific codebases.

name: Fixed context window
description: Five files and 16 chunks may omit coordinated changes across more than five files or loosely associated logic; the paper attributes approximately 15% of failure cases to retrieval.

name: Computational overhead
description: Iterative act/CI execution plus RACG is more resource-intensive and time-consuming than static benchmarks, limiting evaluation scale.

name: Dataset external validity
description: Popularity, CI-pass filtering, clarity/difficulty filtering and four-language coverage select a constrained slice of GitHub software tasks.

name: Reviewer scoring boundary
description: Reviewer reward depends on exposing the submitter without failing the golden patch; prose and Algorithm 1 do not present identical branches for this case.

name: Output-contract inconsistency
description: The main text says all outputs follow structured JSON, H.1 requests code only, and Appendix I examples contain reasoning_trace/code_edits or test_cases JSON.
evidence_sections: 4.1 Experimental Setup / Implementation Details|Appendix H.1|Appendix I Submitter Input

name: Missing matched baselines and uncertainty
description: No human reviewer, static benchmark matched on the same tasks, task counts per matchup, interval, p-value or multiple-comparison analysis is reported.

name: Missing contamination and deployment details
description: The PDF does not provide a repository-overlap audit, hardware, exact API versions, image tags or deployment safety evaluation.

name: dataset coverage
description: Primary evidence is PKU-SafeRLHF-30K and may not represent diverse real-world safety-critical scenarios.

name: model scale
description: Experiments stop at 13B due to memory constraints.

name: hard-constraint conservativeness
description: SafeDPO reaches 100% harmless ratio on XSTest but 12.4% over-refusal, with benign lexical overlap failures.

name: evaluator confounding
description: GPT-based helpfulness incorporates safety judgments; reward-aligned evaluator can overestimate SafeRLHF.

name: XSTest criteria mismatch
description: A privacy-preserving refusal can be defensible yet classified as over-refusal by XSTest.
evidence_sections: E.2 Limitations of XSTest Evaluation Criteria

name: theoretical assumptions
description: Assumption 4.1 requires positive reference mass on safe responses; Assumption A.1 bounds reward; reliability/completeness of binary cost labels is not proved.

name: finite optimization versus global optimum
description: Proposition 4.4 concerns the set of global optima, while finite epochs/capacity can still suffer large-Delta degeneration.

name: statistical uncertainty
description: Main point estimates and human proportions omit intervals, significance tests and annotator agreement; only a 3-seed supplementary table reports standard error.
evidence_sections: 5.1.5 Human Evaluation|C.7 Averages and Standard Errors

name: non_asymptotic_rigor
description: AMP/SE 的正式保证限于 proportional high-dimensional limit；超出该区间的 scaling laws 依赖 conjecture 和数值支持，LASSO/matrix compressed sensing 的 non-asymptotic multiplicative bounds 仍是 open problem。

name: architecture_scope
description: 分析对象限定为 diagonal linear 与 centered quadratic two-layer networks、convex global ERM；结论尚未覆盖一般深层网络或 GD/SGD dynamics。

name: data_target_scope
description: 数据是 isotropic Gaussian teacher–student，目标为 power-law/quasi-sparse spectrum；non-trivial covariance、real data 与其他 target spectrum 留作扩展。

name: quadratic_rank_assumption
description: Appendix D.1 暂假设 S* 为 sub-extensive rank 以使用 BBP-like spectral simplification，再声称误差不显式依赖 c 后将 c→1。

name: diagonal_log_factors
description: diagonal network 的首个 noisy/noiseless rate 只在 logarithmic factors 下成立，具体修正在 Appendix C.2 的式 (86)、(92)。

name: compute_and_numeric_approximation
description: 有限维 quadratic SE 用 Monte Carlo 近似 J、忽略 delta spikes 的导数表示；训练和探索总计约 250000 CPU hours，内存最高 1800 GB。

name: no_dedicated_limitations_section
description: The paper has no heading named Limitations; the explicit self-limit is the need for further neuroscience validation.

name: fixed_object_slots
description: The implementation fixes two objects/MLPs and uses a predefined left/right or top/bottom location set.

name: many_objects_can_be_omitted
description: With too many object-level features, denoising can omit objects; the paper gives one missing player in the m=4 case.

name: prompt_search_subsample
description: Prompt optimization uses 667 randomly sampled NSD training images for efficiency.

name: neuroscience_validation
description: ROI-gradient interpretation is presented as suggestive and explicitly requires further validation.

name: proxy_metrics
description: Perceptual and semantic claims rely on image metrics and a Qwen2.5 QA proxy; no human perceptual evaluation is reported.

name: backbone_coverage
description: SDXL is reported only for PRISM and Mindeye2; remaining methods are compared under SD2.1.

name: missing_reproduction_parameters
description: Participant count, random seeds, batch size, optimizer details, and an end-to-end failure criterion are not stated.

name: ethical_scope
description: The ethics statement says the work uses public data, no personally identifiable/sensitive data, and poses no foreseeable misuse, discrimination, or harm.

name: code_timing
description: The abstract says code is available while §8 says release will occur upon acceptance; availability timing is unresolved in the PDF.

name: Simplified environmental physics
description: The equations capture qualitative effects for agent evaluation rather than accurate physical simulation.

name: Limited interaction model
description: Current device effects are additive and richer Environment→Environment/Device→Device interactions are extension examples.

name: Protocol scope
description: Matter application-layer semantics are implemented; transport security, commissioning, and fabric management are outside scope.

name: Deferred workflow feedback
description: schedule_workflow does not validate future success and returns no execution error, limiting autonomous correction.
evidence_sections: §3.2 Agent-Simulator Interface|§5.3 Role of Tool Feedback

name: Latency boundary
description: GPT-5.1 gains come with roughly 3–5× longer inference and GPT-4.1 reaches up to about 30 seconds in the reported setting.

name: Model and serving confounding
description: Main comparison uses 18 heterogeneous models under ReAct; family, prompt, and serving effects are not fully isolated.

name: No physical transfer experiment
description: The paper proposes world-model pre-validation but reports no physical-home transfer or long-term deployment test.

name: Judge dependence
description: LLM-as-a-Judge is used for all infeasible and QT1-Feasible cases; agreement is κ=0.826 and 5/155 reviewed judgments are misclassified.

name: Generated-query dependence
description: GPT-5 mini drafts natural-language queries and two graduate students correct them; the query distribution is shaped by this process.

name: Small SFT intervention
description: SFT uses 204 trajectories, two models, and GPT-5.1-generated successful teacher trajectories.

name: NoPE arbitrary-language boundary
description: NoPE CoT C-RASP is not Turing-complete over arbitrary languages; PALINDROME is given as the simple counterexample family.

name: log n and Heaviside idealization
description: The formal model assumes log n attention scaling and Heaviside thresholds; ReLU approximation is only asserted at finite input length.

name: idealized length-generalization procedure
description: Definition 2.2/Theorem A.2 rely on a procedure fitting all bounded-length inputs and regularizer minimization; this is a formal guarantee rather than finite-data training theorem.

name: limited empirical task/length scope
description: Only five arithmetic language families and train/test lengths through 300 are evaluated; no arbitrary-language or broad natural-language test is included.

name: capacity and reporting controls
description: BinaryR/BinaryN differ sharply in depth, heads and dimension; seed, hardware, sample denominators and uncertainty are absent.

name: complexity refinement deferred
description: The paper does not relate CoT-step count to complexity classes; it explicitly leaves this as future work.

name: internal label inconsistency
description: Appendix C calls the earlier result “Lemma 2.1” although the main text labels it Proposition 2.1.

name: Reversible or isolated side effects required
description: Irreversible operations such as deleting records or placing orders cannot be naively speculated; fork, snapshot, sandbox or compensation is required.

name: Proposition 1 distributional assumptions
description: Independent hits/latencies, exponential speculative and real calls, beta<alpha and negligible f/pi costs condition the runtime formula.

name: Stochastic live API latency
description: Position difficulty and provider load make chess speed reductions variable and not perfectly reproducible.
evidence_sections: Randomness of agent call in gameplay

name: Strict API metric
description: HotpotQA synonyms and word-order changes count as mismatches, so exact API accuracy is not semantic answer accuracy.

name: Lossy OS scope
description: OS uses last-write-wins and is a separate lossy extension evaluated on one sysbench CPU workload and one hardware setup.

name: Reporting granularity
description: Seed lists, task denominators, error-bar meanings, API prices and full latency distributions are not reported in the read version.

name: Theory-to-experiment gap
description: Depth theorem is analytic only; Theorem 3 is implemented only through a simple constant threshold in chess.

name: CNF posterior runtime
description: CNF posterior requires ODE solves at every gradient step and is much slower than parametric SFA/VAE.

name: posterior family selection
description: Simpler families suffice when latent dimension is much smaller, but principled selection remains open.

name: complex image decoder architecture
description: Scaling to complex images may allow deep decoders to bypass a stochastic latent through skip connections.

name: methodological scope
description: Authors describe the contribution as a composition recipe rather than an already solved identifiable/decomposable latent system.

name: RNA likelihood metric omission
description: For 5000-dimensional observations, CNF log likelihood is omitted because adjoint-ODE cannot directly compute it.

name: offline LDS training
description: The full-sequence posterior makes Eq. (9) training offline rather than an online filtering method.

name: reported uncertainty and generality
description: No seeds, replicate counts, hypothesis tests or conventional intervals are supplied; small cross-method differences are therefore not stability evidence.

name: No formal global-utility theorem
description: The global utility/global CI relationship is explicitly empirical rather than a formal proof.

name: Real-world GT SCM unavailable
description: Real datasets lack identifiable GT SCMs; causal discovery can be unreliable and misleading.

name: CPDAG does not orient every DAG edge
description: CPDAG preserves Markov-equivalence information but is not a full DAG-level causal reconstruction.

name: Static benchmark and current method scope
description: Current coverage is 13 generators/9 categories/29 main datasets and static tabular data; temporal/event data is future work.

name: Generator convergence issues
description: GReaT can fail above 50 features; GOGGLE and TabDDPM can be unstable or fail to converge in stated settings.

name: δ-Presence numerical instability
description: The adopted Synthcity implementation can be numerically unstable; privacy direction differs from utility/density direction.

name: Split-policy sensitivity
description: The independent-set variant changes available training data and can change TabDiff’s Trend behavior.

name: Latent-confounder evidence is limited
description: Confounding experiment uses three SCM datasets and is described as proof-of-concept.

name: standalone_limitations_section
description: No heading or paragraph named Limitations appears between Conclusion and References.

name: low_rank_assumption
description: Appendix C assumes low-rank structure for both gradient direction and elementwise magnitude with residual δ.

name: reference_descent_assumption
description: Convergence anchors LoRA-Pre Adam to an assumed expected descent direction of standard full-rank Adam.

name: beta_extreme_instability
description: β1=.99 and β2=.999 are marked Diverged; factors adapt too slowly as the implicit γ approaches zero.

name: experimental_generality
description: Empirical scope is Llama models, C4 pre-training, MetaMath100k fine-tuning, GSM8K and MATH-500.

name: system_memory_and_runtime
description: No direct memory-byte, throughput, wall-clock, or compute-cost measurement is included.

name: seeds_and_uncertainty
description: No random seeds, independent runs, dispersion, error bars, or significance analysis are provided.

name: deployment_ethics_impact
description: No deployment, ethics, or broader-impact section is present; Appendix E only discloses LLM use.

name: 有序/时序输入约束
description: video encoder 针对 sequential、temporally coherent input；arbitrarily unordered multi-view input 的性能不保证，输入必须排列成模拟 smooth view transitions 的序列。

name: text-to-pointmap 的指标边界
description: 没有 established benchmark 或 baseline，因此 pointmap 生成只做 qualitative evaluation。

name: direct reward 的计算成本
description: 完整 trajectory reward 成本高；论文用 reduced timesteps、K=2 和两个 sampled views 降低成本，但未报告总成本。

name: MVDUSt3R Gaussian scale failure
description: MVDUSt3R 的 Gaussian primitives 跨域 scale estimation 可能失败，评测额外做 source-view 100-step refinement。

name: 复现信息缺口
description: PDF 未提供随机 seeds、硬件型号、总训练时间/计算量、独立 leakage control 或预注册 failure criterion。

name: 伦理/社会影响限制
description: 论文没有 ethics、broader impact 或社会影响限制段落；不能依据任务主题补写。

name: lower-bound guess
description: The lower bound ell is guessed as 10^-3 in bfloat16; an order-of-magnitude error delays convergence by a few iterations, and a two-order error can delay beating Jordan to iteration 13–14.

name: finite-precision non-monotonicity
description: Optimal polynomials can map large singular values down or even negative, causing loss of precision or the wrong polar factor; stabilization sacrifices a small amount of optimality.

name: full-spectrum versus Muon utility
description: Five iterations do not fully converge all singular values even though they converge in top directions relevant to the tested Muon objective; exact SVD does not improve loss.

name: cross-task generality
description: CIFAR/ViT experiments show no consistent advantage for Polar Express and leave further tuning open.

name: rectangular runtime scope
description: Algorithm 3 is numerically delicate in bfloat16; its FLOP savings are not beneficial at GPT-Small scale and may require larger models/aspect ratios.

name: main-text reporting scope
description: Main GPT-2 results report best sweep values and curves without a seed count or uncertainty band; complete hyperparameters are referred to code/supplementary materials.

name: conclusion section
description: There is no standalone Conclusion or Limitations heading; the final main-text section is 4.3 Ablations.

name: Long-input scope boundary
description: ThinKV is not directly applicable to settings dominated by long input contexts.

name: Ambiguous sparsity regimes
description: Some layers have more than three sparsity regimes or ambiguous boundaries; Appendix E.4 highlights difficult GPT-OSS-20B cases.

name: Minimum retention failure
description: Complete eviction minR=0 severely degrades accuracy; the trace says removing or 0-bit quantizing transition thoughts can yield an endless loop.

name: Serving-framework maturity boundary
description: The Transformers/PagedAttention integration is labeled a proof of concept and the vLLM integration targets v1.

name: Uncertainty and seed reporting
description: The PDF states averages across 3 runs and 8 responses but gives no seed values, error bars, intervals, or hypothesis tests.

name: standalone_limitations_section
description: No Limitations heading; limitations are distributed through §3.1, §3.2, §4.3 and tables.

name: data_dependence
description: HQ-Edit and DOCCI have biased data distributions; authors identify curation scope as a limitation.

name: median_only_coverage
description: Easy samples are excluded and hard samples are those not solved even with contrasting; hard failures are not used for rationale generation.

name: easy_overthink
description: Adding easy samples lowers the displayed scores and is attributed to potential overthink on straightforward problems.

name: fixed_similarity_thresholds
description: φq and φv are fixed single values; no threshold sensitivity is shown.

name: rationale_filter_detail
description: Text-matching post-processing is described, but rules, false removals and manual verification are absent.

name: mechanism_identification
description: Pair construction, ground-truth hint, Qwen2.5-72B rethinking and SFT are bundled; no contrast-only mechanism decomposition is reported.

name: model_scope
description: Models shown are Qwen2.5VL-7B, Qwen2.5VL-3B and InternVL2.5-8B; the abstract phrase “various VLMs” is broader than the displayed model set.

name: statistical_reproducibility
description: No seeds, uncertainty, hardware, runtime or per-benchmark denominators are reported.

name: tile-granularity scope
description: Extremely fine-grained behavior below tile level is outside a stable portable API.

name: cost-model overlap assumption
description: Roofline formulation assumes perfect computation/memory-transfer overlap.

name: platform scope
description: Evaluation hardware is H100 and MI300X.

name: out-of-shared-memory cases
description: Figure 9 labels MI300X variants out of smem.

name: recent-DSL comparison caveat
description: Tilus is stated to lack full Hopper WGMMA/TMA optimization.

name: statistical reporting
description: No seed, repetition, timing aggregation, dispersion, uncertainty interval, or hypothesis test appears.

name: No standalone limitations section
description: The main text goes from Conclusion to References; limitations are distributed through assumptions, footnotes and appendices.

name: Theorem 2.1 scope
description: The negative result is for GSSMs with finite state and CoT-only or single-turn interaction, not arbitrary unbounded-memory agents.

name: Theorem 2.2 learner scope
description: The proof requires a task-specific trajectory distribution, a read/write pointer oracle, a halting Turing machine and a simple string-matching learner; it does not prove gradient descent on Mamba/RNN.

name: Addition endpoint
description: The paper says it did not measure accuracy beyond 1,000-digit addition.

name: Hanoi exact-sequence fragility
description: Exponential output length makes exact accuracy seed-sensitive; a high token accuracy does not imply full trajectory accuracy.

name: Coding-task realism boundary
description: The codebase and v10 bug are synthetically generated, and training trajectories are conditioned on successful, shorter-than-average agent runs.

name: Natural-language coverage
description: Only one representative Oolong task with Yahoo Answers examples is evaluated.

name: Uncertainty and denominators
description: Main Figure 1–3 and Table 1 do not report test denominators or a common uncertainty summary; the appendix selectively reports seed envelopes/bars.

name: End-to-end efficiency comparison
description: The paper asserts linear model scaling but gives no end-to-end latency, cost, energy or throughput comparison for the agent systems.

name: Public pretrained SSM tool-use availability
description: The authors report no publicly available SSM fine-tuned for function calling at writing time and evaluate only the nearest coding model they found.

name: training computational overhead
description: One additional backward pass per sequence; approximately 2× standard DPO training time; inference speed/latency is claimed unchanged.

name: reasoning-heavy performance gap
description: TI-DPO trails sequence-level baselines such as GRPO/TPO on MMLU, GPQA and GSM8K because holistic sequence-level consistency may matter.

name: bias amplification

name: bias evaluation
description: No bias benchmark, demographic slice, intervention or mitigation outcome is reported.

name: reproducibility granularity
description: The statement promises full reproducibility, while seed, preference-data size/split, optimizer, hardware, runtime and training budget remain unspecified.

name: independent-assumption dependence
description: independent MARL assumption is acknowledged as unreliable; it remains the source of Stage 1 warm start even though Stage 2 is centralized.

name: virtual policy mapping and approximate gradient
description: P and z are virtual constructs; z is not directly computed, the policy class is restricted by Eq. (5), and Eq. (7) is an approximate policy-gradient update.

name: metric selection and aggregation
description: delivery/detour values count completed orders only; Table 2 has high standard deviation; most appendix tables report no uncertainty.

name: noise choice and unexplored optimum
description: BSC is selected for fairness despite worse noise performance; authors say the optimal noise for this task requires further exploration.

name: centralized single-point failure
description: Conclusion states that dependence on comprehensive information makes Triple-BERT more sensitive to single points of failure; no resilience experiment is supplied.

name: fairness and deployment boundary
description: Ethics Statement raises discriminatory payment/order preferences and proposes fairness constraints, while the experiments contain no subgroup, fairness, carbon, or online-deployment evaluation.

name: stereo_baseline
description: POSE_ENC 限于 stereo，一次前向不能处理 ultra-wide baseline；多视图链路在 self-supervised setting 下如何避免 interpolation 仍开放。

name: rendering_artifacts
description: target pose 偏离 context 时 transferred frame 的 blur/warp 增多；作者把它与 deterministic model 的不确定性处理联系起来。

name: evaluation_scope
description: 附录称继续改善 TPS 与全面评估 transferability 仍是 outstanding problem；TPS 只测几何一致性，还需 perceptual fidelity。

name: reproducibility_detail
description: PDF 给出硬件、优化器、层数和采样 baseline，但没有 seed、train/validation 拆分规模、逐数据集训练曲线或公开实现。

name: no standalone limitations section
description: p.9–10 从 Conclusion 转到 Author Contributions/Acknowledgments/References；没有 Limitations heading。

name: category-level evaluation boundary
description: 作者说类别级 correspondence 取决于 class sizes/distributions，不能显式指定；§4.2 因而主要评估 sample-level mismatch。

name: virtual-sample clean-data boundary
description: 相对 clean 数据上 Virtual Sample 的效果不显著，较小 ρ 可能更好。

name: curve-shaping boundary
description: m 增大时 marginal distribution 过度平滑并带来 slight decline。

name: InfoNCE equivalence assumptions

name: convergence-theory boundary
description: Appendix G 明示在 two-view likelihood、tight E-step 和 bounded likelihood 的推导中得 stationary point；不是 global optimum statement。

name: scope left to future work

name: Image-only modality
description: HydraFake and spatial artifact reasoning do not cover temporal video consistency or video-only artifacts.

name: Low-quality real images
description: DeepFaceLab/FFIW and other low-resolution real images leave room for improvement because reasoning needs visible details.

name: Unseen relighting
description: Face relighting remains a failure cluster; Effort outperforms Veritas on IC-Light.

name: Inference cost
description: High-resolution hard inputs take 54.22 seconds per batch of eight for ours in the reported prototype.

name: Metric and causal evidence
description: No seed variance, conventional uncertainty, significance tests or independently labeled causal faithfulness evaluation is supplied.

name: Ethics/deployment scope
description: Authors state public or synthetic data and academic non-commercial use; deployment governance is not developed.

name: limited viewpoints and missing instance
description: 有限 camera viewpoints 使一个 chair 只被部分观察并从 reconstruction 中缺失，QA 输出 5 而 GT 为 6。

name: oblique view and brief appearance
description: cabinet 顶面仅短暂且多为 oblique angles，几何不完整但 caption 借助 2D cues 仍正确。

name: external task preprocessing
description: Scan2Cap/ScanRefer 使用 Mask3D，Nr3D/Sr3D 使用 segmentation annotations，因而部分任务不是完全由视频直接发现实例。

name: baseline scale and pose asymmetry
description: VGGT† 需要 scale alignment；Uni3DR2 需要 GT camera pose；比较条件不是完全同构。

name: missing uncertainty and compute disclosure
description: 没有 seed、重复次数、区间、参数/FLOPs、GPU 型号/数量或训练时长。

name: no dedicated limitations section
description: 正文没有独立 Limitations 标题；失败边界集中在 Appendix A.1 的 challenging cases。

name: Emergentness source
description: 作者承认 position embeddings、Q/K/V indirection 和 training distribution 可能驱动机制，尚未区分。

name: Synthetic/PUG scope
description: 主文复杂图像证据来自 PUG 的两动物可控场景；COCO real-world 扩展在 Appendix，且 ID order 由模型 enumeration 推断。

name: Family heterogeneity
description: Qwen 的 relative coding 方向清楚，LLaVA 差异 less pronounced；作者只提出 position embeddings 或训练集大小的可能解释。

name: Ceiling exclusion
description: Spatial reasoning 的 Qwen2.5-32B 与 LLaVA-OneVision 已接近 ceiling，干预信息量有限。

name: Model scope
description: 正文七个 core models 的 CMA/intervention 与 Appendix Idefics2 representational-only 不能代表所有 VLM。

name: Statistical reporting
description: 没有 error bars、confidence intervals、p-values 或多重比较说明；文本使用 significantly improved 但未说明检验。

name: Implementation/deployment
description: 代码、训练硬件、完整运行配置和部署验证未在 PDF 提供；复现声明写作将 release。

name: independent limitations section
description: §5.5 末尾直接进入 Context Encoder、ACKNOWLEDGMENTS 和 references，没有单独 limitations 标题。

name: warping does not explicitly model large displacement
description: 每像素只计算一个对应 feature，作者明确说这使其不能显式建模 large displacements，依赖 transformer attention。

name: Ambush 1 adverse effect
description: 作者承认 Ambush 1 严重影响 Sintel Final 平均，并在 Table 6 同时给 full 与 w/o 结果。

name: benchmark and split scope
description: zero-shot 只在 Sintel(train)、KITTI(train)；submission protocol 对不同 benchmark 使用不同 fine-tuning。
