description: memory 是 RTX A6000/batch=1；latency 是 RTX3090/batch=1/540p；无跨硬件或功耗报告。

name: subjective_preference_labels
description: 作者承认 preference modeling 具有固有主观性，guidelines 不能完全剥离 personal preference 与 objective quality。

name: annotator_pool_bias
description: 有限 annotation pool 可能反映特定 demographic／professional group，尤其影响 ambiguous cases。

name: benchmark_scale
description: 当前 WebDevJudge 规模为 654 instances，作者保留更大的 filtered set 供 future data augmentation。

name: front_end_scope
description: Likert 设计聚焦 front-end 基础，明确省略 backend performance 与 efficiency 等更高层标准。
evidence_sections: Appendix C.2 Evaluation Protocols and Metrics

name: rubric_granularity
description: LLM-generated rubric 对 general query 有时过细或过宽，可能在评测中增加 ambiguity。

name: generalization_to_unseen_embodied_environments
description: Web-video pretrained models may revert to training priors or ignore action controls in unseen embodied environments, creating physically/semantically inconsistent rollouts.

name: long_horizon_planning
description: Visual WMs model short-term change but lack mechanisms for accumulated spatiotemporal history; panorama substitution had inconsistent gains.

name: precise_physical_dynamics
description: Contact-rich interaction, compliance, friction, and articulated/deformable state changes remain difficult; erroneous rollouts degrade control.

name: policy_floor
description: Total performance depends on world-model fidelity and proposal/revision policy strength; base policies set a floor and stronger policies raise a ceiling.

name: inference_cost
description: Multiple simulated futures add compute overhead and may be impractical under strict real-time or limited hardware constraints.

name: weaker_manipulation_gain
description: SVD† manipulation gain over VLM is modest, and the authors connect this to fine-grained motion/dynamics difficulty.

name: Predefined reaction/starting-block assumption
description: synthesis guarantee 依赖三类 predefined reactions、functional-group compatibility 与可用 starting blocks；A.1 假设 blocks 全部 available。

name: Fallback 不等于 guaranteed inference
description: rule-based tokenizer 扩展 training coverage，但不等价于 synthesis-guaranteed inference；strict tokenizer 只覆盖 corpus 的 26.7%。

name: 数字 route 不是 wet-lab validation
description: Allchemy 是 digital retrosynthesis route search，SA 是 quick heuristic；论文未执行其自身的 wet-lab synthesis。

name: oracle 范围与标签来源
description: oracle 只覆盖六项 ADMET properties，高层标签由 model ensemble 合成；没有 in vivo/clinical 或 human evaluation。

name: FDA/case-study 范围
description: 主分布为 122 个 synthesis-guaranteed FDA structures；430-drug 扩展无 guarantees；fallen angels 只有 Evobrutinib 与 TNG348。

name: 多目标 trade-off
description: critical reasoning 是局部 property 修改；作者承认其它重要 properties 可能被牺牲，未给全局多目标保证。

name: 模型/词汇规模
description: Qwen 3B 与 1000-block training vocabulary 是当前预算选择；更大 vocabulary/backbone 只列为 scaling future work。

name: Allchemy dynamic range 与 baseline 对称性
description: H 指出简单 FDA 分布可能使 Allchemy dynamic range 受限；HierVAE per-property fine-tune 且使用 mCLM-preprocessed distribution。

name: Physical-world impact 未闭合
description: Observe–Think–Propose 的 Propose 尚未由本论文实际合成/实验闭环验证。

name: simulation_external_validity
description: Automated conversations are not representative of natural human-AI dialogue; findings are framed as a controlled stress test.

name: narrow_conversation_structure
description: At most one new shard is revealed per turn; the final turn contains all required information; high-level intent is always present in the first turn.

name: minimal_shards
description: Minimal shards may be unrealistic and potentially adversarial.

name: sharded_scoring_advantage
description: Maximum-over-turn scoring gives SHARDED more answer opportunities than FULL, including lucky guesses or memorized answers.

name: analytical_tasks_only
description: The six tasks require analytical solutions; creative writing and other open-ended domains are outside the evidence.

name: english_text_only
description: Other languages and multimodal user or assistant utterances are not tested.

name: regular_context_only
description: The study is not a long-context stress test; most tasks fit within 8k and all within 20k tokens.

name: summary_model_exclusions
description: Phi-4 and OLMo-2-13B are excluded from Summary because of context limits.

name: api_reproducibility
description: Closed API models may be deprecated, preventing exact future reruns.

name: stochastic_reproducibility
description: Ten repetitions leave statistical variance; larger repetition budgets might reveal missed findings.

name: gradual_sharding_selection
description: Gradual sharding uses inherently complex eight-shard source instructions, limiting the two-turn generalization.

name: mechanism_identification
description: Mechanism analyses are observational and task-restricted; the paper often uses 'hypothesize' or 'likely' for causal explanations.

name: summary_metric_length_bias
description: Joint Score is recall-based and favors longer summaries; outputs above 300 words are truncated proportionally before evaluation.

name: translation_metric_scope
description: BLEU may not capture document-level nuances, weakening the translation scope test.

name: model scope
description: 所有正式 theorem 对象是 UHAT；softmax 与 average-hard attention 的 succinctness 未解决。

name: precision assumptions differ by result
description: UHAT upper bounds允许 arbitrary rational weights；RNN comparison 假设 fixed precision。

name: floating-point evaluation order
description: fixed-precision carry-over 依赖确定的 evaluation order；换序需重新核查 associativity-based identities。

name: worst-case counter dependence
description: EXPSPACE hardness 需要编码巨大 counters；无法编码该结构的 subclass 可能有更低 verification complexity。

name: learnability not established
description: succinct representability 不回答这些 UHAT 是否可学习；作者称经验结果 mixed。

name: state-space-model extension underformalized
description: abstract/intro 对 SSM 使用“by extension”，正文没有专门的 SSM 定义、size measure 或 corollary。

name: standalone limitations section
description: 没有独立 Limitations section；边界散布于 §1、footnote 3 和 §6。

name: functional identification rather than learning-trajectory reconstruction
description: Eq. (4) isolates functionally separable subspaces of the converged manifold; it conflates pretraining and fine-tuning contributions instead of reconstructing concept-specific historical perturbations.

name: concept dataset requirement
description: The method requires explicit target X+ and reference X− datasets, requiring human labels or domain knowledge.

name: retrospective-only estimation
description: The current framework cannot enter the training loop for online tracking or apply directly to streaming/incremental learning.

name: covariance storage at larger scale
description: Although it avoids O(Nd) activation storage, d×d covariances can become substantial at 8B–70B scale.

name: compute-accuracy trade-off
description: The main text states that Engram trails AltPO, NPO, and SimNPO on Overall and Privacy metrics, while using a one-pass gradient-free regime.

name: scope: bilinear two-player zero-sum theory
description: The theory targets bilinear two-player zero-sum games; Markov games are an unproved possible analogue.

name: assumption: unknown and potentially tiny mu threshold
description: The game-dependent threshold can be arbitrarily small in the worst case.

name: compute: one-sided guarantee requires two runs for a pair
description: Corollary 3.2 guarantees one player; a full pair requires two role-flipped runs.

name: assumption: no dilated AsymP-DGDA convergence proof
description: Global smoothness of the dilated regularizer is unavailable near the strategy-space boundary.

name: generality: empirical extensive-form scope
description: The extensive-form claim rests on five game instances and curves, not a general guarantee.

name: reproducibility: extensive-form uncertainty details
description: No seed count, repeat count, raw trajectory distribution, or error display is supplied for Figure 4.

name: PV oracle fallibility
description: 作者明确承认 text-only reasoner 可能产生 false negatives；保护项只在失败轨迹上缓解惩罚，不等于 oracle calibration。

name: Textual-grounding scope
description: 作者承认迷宫等视觉模式不能简单转成文本，并将论证范围收窄到 explicit multimodal reasoning/System 2。

name: Causal attribution ambiguity
description: 当 blindfolded proxy 自身推理失败时，PV 将失败归因给 perception；该误归因风险由方法讨论而非独立实验解决。

name: Benchmark and verifier scope
description: 主结果覆盖九个 benchmark cell，verifier 评估使用人工构造的 N=273 challenge set；未展示更广泛部署分布。

name: Seed and uncertainty reporting
description: PDF 未报告 MoCA 训练/评测 seed、主 benchmark 离散度、区间或主结果的统计检验；“significant”主要是叙述性形容。

name: No dedicated limitations section
description: 正文从 §4 Related Work 直接进入 p.9 Impact Statement/References，没有题为 Limitations 的章节；限制主要散落在 §2.3 和实验附录。

name: Ethics/deployment discussion
description: Impact Statement 仅以通用句说明没有需要特别强调的社会后果，未给出具体 deployment/ethics 分析。

name: complex reasoning generality
description: CAT-Q has severe degradation on math and code pilot tasks.

name: deployment kernels
description: Public 1.58-bit kernels are limited to BitNet models; diverse-model support remains under-optimized.

name: FP16 performance gap
description: The authors state room remains to reduce the gap to FP16, especially on complex reasoning.

name: reproducibility reporting
description: No random seeds, repeats or uncertainty summaries are reported.

name: Table B model identity
description: The visible Table B does not identify the evaluated model.

name: No dedicated technical limitations section
description: The paper has no Limitations heading; boundaries are distributed across implementation, future work, and impact discussion.

name: Compute boundary
description: Stage II is said to take approximately one day on eight GPUs; this is an implementation fact rather than a named limitation.

name: Generality evidence boundary
description: Training/benchmark discussion is Chinese-subtitle centered; other languages are presented qualitatively without per-language metrics.

name: Misuse
description: Impact Statement acknowledges potential misinformation use and proposes license stipulations.

name: positivity / sufficient variability
description: 要求每个 target realization 对 bias attributes 有 support；B 是 Y 的 deterministic function 时 observational debiasing 一般不可识别。

name: selective mediation
description: 部分 mediator 可携带稳定任务信号，需从 B 中移至 W_stable；默认将 mediator 当 bias 的范围有限。

name: unobserved confounding and proxies
description: 遗漏 Z-prime 时 criterion 无法保证绝对 causal stability；在 input 没有 valid proxy 的条件下只保证阻断 observed B paths。

name: SAM-theory dependence
description: §6 说明 theoretical guarantees fundamentally conditional on SAM assumptions。

name: observed bias labels
description: DISCO 属于 informed bias mitigation，需要训练时显式观察和标注 bias variables。

name: unconstrained deployment
description: fully unsupervised scenarios 被列为 future work，正文没有将其作为已解决能力。

name: demographic-label semantics
description: FairFace 的 labeled sex 与内部 gender 区分；原 race taxonomy 被拒绝并以 skin tone proxy 处理。

name: initial sDISCO implementation discrepancy
description: Appendix B 说明旧数学式与代码实现不一致，主文结果已更新；旧表保留作 transparency。

name: Training family
description: Training is exclusively on up-to-10-mode GMMs; targets far from GMMs require retraining or finetuning.

name: Rotation equivariance
description: Whitening gives exact translation/scaling but rotation invariance only approximately through augmentation.

name: Asymptotic consistency
description: The paper says DiScoFormer has no proven asymptotic guarantees.

name: Reproduction detail
description: Seeds, optimizer, learning rate, loss alpha and code URL are not present in the PDF.

name: Impact statement
description: The statement locates generic generative-model misuse but says no ethical concern is unique to this work.

name: Associative rather than causal structure
description: The paper explicitly states that causal constraints or Mendelian randomization are future extensions.

name: Linear observation model
description: The linear observation model preserves interpretability and closed-form CAVI updates, while nonlinear predictors remain future work.

name: No longitudinal pathway activation
description: Longitudinal EHR and time-varying pathway activation are not modeled.

name: High-dimensional genetic scaling
description: Scaling to high-dimensional genetic features may require stochastic or amortized VI.

name: Permutation symmetry and exact edge labels
description: Repulsion reduces redundancy but does not break permutation symmetry; claims rely on relabeling-stable quantities.

name: Structural discovery compute and memory
description: The UKB run uses 27.8 GB and 73.7 minutes of training, despite inference below 0.1 ms.

name: Real-world structural ground truth unavailable
description: The paper evaluates structure against ground truth in simulation because it is unavailable for real EHR; UKB structure is checked through PIPs, prediction, and cases.

name: Reproducibility details incomplete
description: The code URL is provided, but seeds, convergence thresholds, complete hyperparameters, and initialization count are absent from the PDF.

name: External validation
description: No external healthcare cohort or prospective validation appears in the PDF.

name: token-dependent equivalence
description: Exact update matches the next-token distribution for a specific history; free generation changes attention values and requires recomputation.

name: mechanistic versus algorithmic interpretation
description: A weight-difference representation does not establish that inference executes the derived learning algorithm.

name: architectural prerequisites
description: Output controllability is required; Appendix D proves the fixed-scale post-RMSNorm boundary.

name: low-precision numerical instability
description: Direct Δm division can be unstable near zero; bfloat16 base condition shows lower agreement.

name: global reusable patch
description: The paper explicitly says the derived changes do not yield a global update that absorbs context for every query.

name: reproducibility reporting
description: Seeds, denominators, hardware, runtime, image provenance, and code source are absent from the PDF.

name: Direct cumulative-error computation
description: The paper says direct Eq. (8) calculation has unacceptable complexity and lacks an explicit per-step error solution.

name: Jacobian approximation
description: Approximation 1 sets Jxt≈0; Appendix A frames it as a magnitude-based simplification with SDXL W4A4 checks rather than an exact equality.

name: m=1 derivation conditions
description: The upper-bound argument invokes timestep-independent bounded quantization error and a bounded Jacobian/Lipschitz condition.

name: Low-step performance boundary
description: Appendix G states improvement is constrained when steps are fewer than 3 because little error accumulates.

name: Dedicated limitations section
description: There is no separate limitations heading; Conclusion contains positive recap and no explicit boundary paragraph.

name: Uncertainty reporting
description: No repeated-run spread, seed list, confidence interval, hypothesis test, bootstrap, or multiple-comparison correction is supplied for the main tables.

name: Dense-regime computational cost
description: An exact dense decomposition requires a full-hypergrid linear system that becomes prohibitive in high dimension.

name: Sparse greedy-rank bottleneck
description: Sparse support reduces system size, but the greedy rank search becomes the dominant bottleneck.

name: Sparse-regime non-uniqueness
description: Rank-deficient dictionaries admit equivalent representations; selecting a meaningful decomposition remains an open criterion.

name: Continuous-input scope
description: Continuous domains are named as future work, not covered by the current exact categorical framework.

name: Repeated-run uncertainty reporting
description: No seed, repetitions, confidence intervals, or resampling procedure is reported for the numerical tables.

name: Code artifact availability
description: A supplementary code artifact is asserted but absent from this verified-preprint input set.

name: Synthetic-task scope
description: Conclusion explicitly limits the theory and evidence to synthetic tasks.

name: Restricted attention scope
description: Conclusion identifies restricted Transformer attention mechanisms as a limitation.

name: Real-data gap
description: Conclusion names real function-composition datasets and naturalistic workloads as future work.

name: NH mechanism gap
description: The NH separation is said not to be directly characterized by function composition.

name: Optimization sensitivity
description: Appendix distinguishes learnability effects from expressivity in the window and small-scale sweeps.

name: Hardware and runtime evidence
description: No hardware configuration, latency, throughput, or end-to-end memory measurement is reported for the experiments.

name: Cost-structure scope
description: Fused streaming requires the stated affine dot-product structure. Raw Euclidean distance and learned neural costs are outside the current path.

name: Small-n/high-d regime
description: Tensorized baselines can be competitive when n is small or d is high and the dense matrix fits memory; Table 10–11 show d=1024 reversals.

name: Low-epsilon conditioning
description: As epsilon decreases, sensitivity conditioning deteriorates, regularized HVP is used, and convergence needs more CG/Sinkhorn iterations.

name: Extreme rectangularity
description: Extreme aspect ratios expose too few row blocks and lower speedup.

name: HVP approximation
description: Damping and CG tolerance produce an approximate HVP; default parity errors are about 0.5 percent.

name: Hardware/generalization evidence
description: All reported experiments use one A100-80GB configuration; cross-GPU measurements are not present.

name: Uncertainty reporting
description: Timing means and selected medians/counts are given, while confidence intervals, standard deviations, and hypothesis tests are not reported.

name: Low-k occupancy
description: FlashSketch is most advantageous when A is dense and k≪d but large enough to saturate the GPU; low k limits speedups.

name: Large-κ input-read cost
description: Very large κ increases input reads and can limit speedups.

name: κ selection is empirical
description: The paper empirically chooses the Pareto-optimal κ and leaves an adaptive choice for future work.

name: Theory/implementation permutation mismatch
description: Theory assumes independent uniform permutations, while the kernel samples edge-disjoint distinct structured permutations with dependence between neighborhoods.

name: OSE scope
description: The authors do not prove direct guarantees for their Gram-matrix metric or downstream learning performance.

name: Statistical uncertainty reporting
description: The PDF reports timing means, geomeans, and LDS averages but no confidence interval, hypothesis test, multiple-comparison procedure, or random-seed count.

name: single_layer_scope
description: Formal analysis focuses on single-layer attention and does not capture layer interactions or multi-head structure.

name: missing_layernorm_and_extensions
description: LayerNorm effects and multi-layer/multi-head extensions are left for future work.

name: preliminary_empirical_support
description: Synthetic and small-scale natural-language experiments are described as preliminary support.

name: one_epoch_batch_variance
description: Real-world 1-epoch training has high batch-composition variance, and retraction may appear even for the most frequent tokens.

name: experimental_reproducibility_gap
description: Seeds, run count, hardware, full budget, code source, and a resolution of the π inconsistency are absent from the read version.

name: uniform finite precision
description: Assumption 4.3 uses a uniform grid although fp16 spacing changes with exponent；Appendix C.2 and G.2 give a refinement。

name: fully used ball and equal-volume cells
description: Section 4.1 identifies these as two crucial worst-case assumptions；Sections 5.2–5.3 relax them empirically。

name: arbitrary-prompt condition
description: Assumption 4.9 is explicitly called non-trivial；Appendix D supplies scaling intuition and Appendix E supplies a different elementary-operation condition。

name: cramming compute cost
description: 随着 m 增大，cramming 被称为 prohibitively expensive；论文因而用 copying task 间接检验 arbitrary-length prediction。

name: unmeasured arbitrary-length theorem and lower bounds
description: Section 7 将 Theorem 4.10 的 empirical evaluation 与 theoretical lower bounds 列为 future work。

name: statistical and optimization uncertainty
description: 20-target mean、sigmoid fits 与一套 optimizer hyperparameters 没有伴随 seeds、intervals、restarts 或 search-sensitivity 结果。

name: Additive-pricing scope
description: Analysis focuses on additive mechanisms; quality-based and multi-behavior contracts remain future work.

name: Plausibility verification infrastructure
description: Providers would only be forced to report plausible tokenizations if users can verify plausibility; TEE and ZKP are suggested, not implemented.

name: Heuristic and defense completeness
description: Algorithm 2 may not be the most sophisticated exploitation method; other defenses may exist.

name: Other provider misreporting
description: A proprietary provider can misreport next-token distributions or publish a tokenizer different from its internal one.

name: Verbosity remains exploitable
description: Pay-per-character does not stop a provider from increasing the character count by increasing model verbosity.

name: Evaluation coverage
description: Only open-weight Llama, Gemma, and Ministral models are evaluated; LMSYS prompts may not represent real-world prompt distribution.

name: Market-equilibrium scope
description: The model is a single-user/single-provider micro interaction; user choice and multi-provider competition require separate treatment.

name: Legal and reputational deterrence
description: Terms of service and reputation may constrain misreporting, although the paper argues strong incentives can still lead to breaches.

name: Language-dependent provider margin
description: A small number of pay-per-character outputs have negative margin, including lower-than-average characters-per-token non-English outputs.

name: alpha_requires_separate_policy
description: 每个 α 训练单独 policy，成本高且不保证细粒度 trade-off 控制。

name: alpha_and_expert_steering_instability
description: α=10 有 training instability；expert steering 进一步削弱 α controllability。

name: full_diffusion_not_optimal
description: BL=L policy 在中高 NFE 落后 BL=32，作者说 policies remain far from optimal。

name: domain_transfer_boundary
description: 数学 mixture 训练 policy 在 coding，特别是 HumanEval，未完整迁移。

name: padding_compute_waste
description: BL32-slow policy 在 EOS 后有时未并行 unmask padding，造成 wasted compute。

name: ethics_or_deployment_limitations
description: 未见独立 ethics、deployment 或 broader-impact limitations section。

name: small_discrete_primitive_set
description: 当前 formulation 假设 relatively small, discrete primitive set 与 short program length。

name: human_and_causal_semantics
description: reconstruction 归纳 primitive semantics，不保证对齐 human-interpretable concepts 或 causal factors。

name: deterministic_stopping
description: deterministic execution 与 reconstruction-based stopping 在 noise、ambiguity、partial observability 下可能脆弱。

name: synthetic_benchmark_scope
description: 实验限制在 controlled synthetic benchmarks。

name: scaling_cost
description: NEO sequential rollout 约两倍 training cost；NEO-S 的 budget 直接增加 cost。

name: Arithmetic_length_OOD
description: pure NEO 在 arithmetic long-horizon exact factorization 上很低，search 才显著改善。

name: deployment_and_ethics
description: Impact Statement 不针对 human subjects、personal data 或 automated decision-making；只给一般 ML misuse 提示。

name: Precomputed bounds
description: Requires Mi, ci, L and C; they may be unavailable or too loose.

name: Hyperparameter dependence
description: Performance depends on minibatch-size and estimator-variance hyperparameters.

name: Independent-data scope
description: Current algorithms are designed for independent-data likelihoods.

name: Unknown speedup mechanism
description: The source of reported empirical speedups remains unclear.

name: Fixed-step SGLD behavior
description: SGLD decreases MSE early and then plateaus, consistent with fixed-step-size bias.

name: No paper-specific societal impact
description: Impact Statement says no societal consequences need highlighting.

name: Binary-reward scope
description: The main framework currently assumes binary reward and does not directly extend to continuous/arbitrary rewards.

name: Zero-success gradient starvation
description: If no sampled rollout succeeds, the practical estimators give zero gradient for that task.
evidence_sections: 4.1 Empirical Gradient Estimator|M.1 Non-Zero Gradient Signal Analysis

name: Finite rollout approximation
description: Finite T approximates rather than equals the infinite ML expansion; practical baseline shifts unbiased truncation from N to N−1.

name: On-policy scope
description: Experiments intentionally use fully on-policy updates and leave off-policy PPO-style training for future work.

name: Baseline guarantee
description: The average-score baseline is empirically helpful but lacks a theoretical variance-reduction guarantee.
evidence_sections: 4.3 On-Policy Implementation|M.2 Policy Gradient Variance Analysis

name: Perfect-verifier condition on efficiency
description: Reported test-time scaling efficiency explicitly filters solutions with a perfect verifier.

name: Non-binary evidence scope
description: The non-binary extension has one initial modified-maze study; full theory and broader evaluation are future work.

name: local smoothness assumption
description: Appendix A uses a minimal first-order-optimization analysis and explicitly declines to claim global validity for large language models.

name: timing-study scope
description: Timing/weight experiments use the Starcoder mixture and only 70M/160M models.

name: future generality
description: The conclusion calls for tests at larger scales, broader domains, RL-based posttraining, and multi-stage curricula.

name: continued-pretraining timing confound
description: Compared starts differ because of data availability, so the continued-pretraining table does not isolate mixture weight from timing.

name: proxy-to-mechanism gap
description: Theory concerns gradient alignment, while experiments report token-level proximity and CKA rather than direct gradients.

name: uncertainty reporting
description: Tables are described as 5-seed averages, but no standard deviation, standard error, interval, or mean-comparison test is supplied on the reported pages.

name: deployment and data governance
description: The impact statement says there is no new data collection or deployment and asks practitioners to follow data-governance and copyright practices.

name: task and resolution scope
description: The work focuses on moderate-resolution image classification and standard architectures; transfer to higher-resolution, dense prediction and diverse backbones is unclear.

name: direct margin measurement
description: The margin-centric interpretation is optimization-oriented; robust-margin statistics and tail distributions are future work.

name: compute and implementation detail
description: LS-PGD gives a 1.4× speedup, but hardware, complete timing protocol and all defaults are not stated.

name: uncertainty and leakage
description: Five-run means are reported without seeds, dispersion, intervals, tests or leakage audit.

name: deployment and societal validation
description: No user/deployment study or privacy audit is performed; Impact Statement recommends such audits in real systems.

name: Computational cost
description: Algorithm 1 的 time complexity 随 D_max 指数增长；Section 7 以 UMDP NP-hardness 说明 polynomial-time algorithm unlikely。

name: Tabular finite-horizon scope
description: 正文主设置是 finite-horizon, time-homogeneous tabular MDP with finite S,A and known reward。
evidence_sections: 2.2. Markov Decision Process|2.2. Markov Decision Process

name: Delay-observation assumptions
description: Assumption 1 requires independent inter-arrival draws, clipped D_h, and known D_max; unknown P_delay case reveals original deltas only after an episode.

name: Generalization boundary
description: Theorem 5 is conditional on Assumption 2; the conclusion’s beyond-tabular language is not accompanied by non-tabular evidence.

name: Dedicated limitations section
description: 没有名为 Limitations 的独立模块；边界散见 preliminaries, problem setting, Section 7 and theorem conditions。

name: upfront gradient cost
description: Per-sample gradient computation is expensive, although authors say it is amortized across queries.

name: whole-video unit
description: Averaging a full video can dilute short motion-relevant intervals with static or redundant segments.

name: camera-only motion
description: Motion masks may overemphasize ego/camera movement; down-weighting is used but full disentanglement remains future work.

name: classifier-free guidance mismatch
description: CFG is not explicitly modeled, so training-time attribution may not capture inference-time dynamics.

name: base capability trade-offs
description: Targeted motion adaptation may trade off broader base-model capabilities.

name: main-body limitation disclosure
description: The formal limitation block is in Appendix G.2; abstract, introduction, and conclusion do not state limitations.

name: optimize 仅表示 improvement
description: 脚注撤回数学最优含义，故不能把 OMAC 表述成 optimal solver。

name: 缺少 optimization theory
description: 没有 landscape、收敛或 optimal configuration guarantee；作者留给 future work。

name: 训练计算成本
description: 每个 HumanEval 维度约 1,400 API calls；50% 子集约 $5，但评估可能有 variance。

name: 黑箱 actor 与 bias
description: Comparator 偶尔生成劣于 positive 的候选；全训练集重新评估后转作 negative，但未量化 bias。

name: 多维算法形态
description: 当前逐维迭代以稳定 contrastive reasoning；真正 simultaneous joint optimization 留作未来。

name: 集中式 MAS
description: 目标主要是 flat/sequential；centralized MAS 的 master-subordinate communication 需改造。

name: 功能组件覆盖
description: 实验主要是 prompt 和 in-context examples；memory/retrieval 尚无实验。

name: tool-use 范围
description: GAIA 提供额外结果；更复杂的 SWE-bench/tool interaction 留作未来。

name: 数据、模型与任务范围
description: 主结果集中于三基准和 GPT-3.5；跨模型结果仅 code，外推边界有限。

name: 伦理与社会影响
description: Impact Statement 写作者认为没有需要特别强调的社会后果，未提供单独伦理研究。

name: titled_limitations_section
description: No standalone Limitations, Broader Impact, Ethics, or deployment section appears before References.

name: frozen_optimizer_geometry
description: Muon freezes the Newton-Schulz operator and AdamW freezes RMS geometry for candidate scoring; these are stated assumptions rather than bounded approximations.

name: isotropic_hessian
description: The redundancy term replaces an intractable validation Hessian with Hval approximately I; no approximation-error study is shown.

name: proxy_definition_protocol
description: The retrieved Dproxy description and the validation-split proxy sentence leave the actual run-level proxy protocol under-specified.

name: repetition_and_hardware_reporting
description: The paper gives no training-run seed count, GPU model, GPT-2 world size, or variance estimate for main results.

name: mechanism_isolation
description: No direct raw-gradient-versus-preconditioned OPUS ablation isolates the central geometry claim.

name: failure_and_deployment_scope
description: No selection failure cases, deployment behavior, or ethical impact analysis is supplied; the conclusion only names future data mixtures.

name: method scope
description: PRISM is tailored to LoRA-style fixed-rank updates; other PEFT methods require their own intrinsic geometry.

name: runtime cost
description: Geometry-aware operations create runtime overhead, while Table 5 reports nearly unchanged peak memory.

name: task heterogeneity
description: PRISM is not best on SST-2, RTE, and AQuA in the primary table.

name: late clipping saturation
description: Factor-space saturation can flatten late gauge curves and reduce diagnostic interpretability.

name: attack evaluation
description: The PDF states a DP guarantee and impact expectation but has no empirical privacy-attack experiment.

name: Dark or low-quality inputs
description: 模型可能同时难以解释内容和执行有效 adjustment，导致 unsatisfactory edits。

name: Already high-quality inputs
description: 输入已经具有较高质量时，系统可能添加低价值变化，或直接拒绝编辑。

name: User-expectation mismatch
description: 技术上合理的 modifications 仍可能无法匹配 user expectations。

name: Default computational cost
description: 默认配置总处理时间约 470s，MCTS planner 为主要成本；简单图像可减少 simulations。

name: Incomplete empirical reproducibility protocol
description: 指定 PDF 没有给出 seeds、data split、training budget、完整 hardware、participant demographics、exact baseline versions 或 failure adjudication protocol。

name: Selection–measurement coupling
description: 系统用 evaluator 的最高 candidate score 选择下一状态，而 UGC Score 又作为最终 metric；论文未提供 hold-out evaluator 或独立 human metric。此处是基于方法和指标定义的测量边界。

name: Missing Appendix H prompt/memory details
description: §3 唯一把 prompt/memory history design 指向 Appendix H，但实际指定 PDF 只列 Appendix A–G；该组件细节无法从本 PDF 复现。

name: Cross-domain applicability remains future work
description: medical/scientific/artistic images只提出 deterministic editors、plugin interface、domain-specific reward/metric 等扩展方向，没有跨域实验。

name: placement_and_frequency_generalization
description: 性能收益依赖 placement/frequency 调参，未必直接迁移到 unseen domains。

name: high_diversity_subtle_anomalies
description: UCF-Crime 等 scene diversity 高或 anomaly cues subtle 的数据集稳定性较弱。

name: compute_complexity
description: disentanglement 增加 architectural complexity 和 computation overhead，可能限制 real-time/resource-constrained scalability。

name: high_resolution_generalization
description: privacy-unconstrained、high-resolution datasets 仍探索不足，resolution 与 anomaly characteristics 的关系留给 future work。

name: over_suppression
description: large k 或 high lambda_face 会过度移除 feature content，可能伤害 discriminative cues。
evidence_sections: Appendix L. Additional Results and Evaluations

name: identity_anomaly_entanglement
description: identity 与 anomaly-relevant components entangled 时，G-OPL 可能移除弱相关的 task signal。
evidence_sections: Appendix L. Additional Results and Evaluations

name: scale
description: 模型最高1.3B，data-model ratio 低于 state-of-the-art；作者将更大规模列为 future step。

name: combination_generality
description: data/weight mixture 仅为 proof of concept，source 数量和优化程度有限。

name: compute
description: MULTIPLICATION 使用3 seeds；部分规模/下游结果没有完整 seed variance。

name: data_length
description: §5 input length 为8–64 grid；延长至128时仅 SET 稳定受益。

name: metric_uncertainty
description: matched savings 与主曲线没有常规误差带或区间；部分附录表给 mean±SD。

name: mechanism_causality
description: layer localization、entropy、shuffle/noise 是诊断干预，未识别具体 circuit 或训练动力学。

name: deployment
description: FLOP reduction 从 token savings 间接推得，没有 hardware、wall-clock 或 energy measurement。

name: ethics_impact
description: Impact Statement 没有具体社会后果或风险分析。

name: backbone_scope
description: The established output is Cα backbone structure; sequence, side chains and all-atom generation are outside the experiments.

name: length_scope
description: AFDB training covers lengths 32–256; the long-protein extension needs a 26K PDB fine-tuning set and degrades at 500–700 residues.

name: scale_scope
description: Unseen five-scale inference retains distribution metrics better than designability, which drops to 72.6%.

name: motif_scope
description: Motif scaffolding is teacher-forced at motif coordinates and its zero-shot success rates vary from 0 to 7.2%.

name: baseline_data_scope
description: Some baseline values are copied from Geffner et al.; the PDB data used in that work are not publicly available and are reconstructed here.
evidence_sections: 4.1 Protein Backbone Generation|C.3 Long Protein Generation

name: statistical_scope
description: No seed count, uncertainty interval, hypothesis test, multiple-comparison procedure or energy/cost measure is reported.

name: mechanism_scope
description: The explanation that larger AR modules worsen exposure bias is proposed from ablation behavior; direct overfitting or error-accumulation measurements are absent.
evidence_sections: C.7 Ablating AR and Decoder Size

name: future_scope
description: Conformational dynamics, all-atom, multi-chain and other biomolecule generation are future directions rather than tested capabilities.

name: Coarse-grained largest-domain target
description: TEDBench assigns a protein-level label from the largest annotated domain and may miss smaller biologically relevant domains; future work could segment and classify domains individually.

name: Transfer scope beyond structural categorization
description: The paper has not tested function prediction or interaction modeling.

name: Large-scale compute accessibility
description: Aggressive masking reduces pretraining cost, but training large models still requires substantial resources and may limit accessibility.

name: Single external-source boundary
description: The transfer test is one CATH v4.4 40% non-redundant experimental set; cross-database and cross-protocol coverage is not established.

name: Unreported run-level uncertainty
description: Results and ablations do not report seeds, repeated-run dispersion or statistical decision rules.

name: signal-regularizer separation
description: Task signal and regularization noise may couple through gradient accumulation.

name: single-agent scope
description: All experiments are single-agent; multi-agent propagation remains open.

name: criterion gaming
description: A capable model could inflate reward variance over long horizons.

name: reward reliability
description: Reward variance degrades as a signal proxy in sparse or noisy environments.

name: exploration coverage and tuning
description: Aggressive filtering may narrow exploration coverage and kept mass requires per-task tuning.

name: filtered-objective bias
description: The Appendix J estimator is unbiased for its filtered mean but generally biased for the unfiltered mean.

name: unreported replication uncertainty
description: The PDF reports no seed counts, intervals, or hypothesis tests for the main result grid.

name: no_general_context_free_guarantee
description: Table 1 explicitly marks all Context-Free Languages unavailable; §4.2 subsequently narrows a discussion of some quantitative recognitions to high-precision/specific-bias conditions.

description: Expressivity setup conditions results on exact/bounded-precision arithmetic; Base-2 notes Float64 significand limitation beyond L>53.

name: unitary_regime_boundary
description: Theorem 27 bound uses gamma<1; its own remark says gamma=1 relies on exact group structure and sufficient precision instead.

name: random_feature_compactness
description: Theorem 20 scales d with the number of finite histories; Proposition 22 motivates learned transitions via compactness.

name: empirical_scope
description: Reported validation consists of synthetic probes; conclusion identifies massive-dataset pre-training as future work.

name: baseline_and_runtime_scope
description: SSMs are a theoretical proxy rather than measured baseline; latency isolates sequence mixers at B=1.

name: dedicated_limitations_ethics_deployment_section
description: The document passes from conclusion to acknowledgments/references without a named Limitations, ethics, broader-impact or deployment section.

name: SFT supervision dependence
description: TAQ 依赖 SFT dataset 的 supervision signal；若 reasoning traces weak/noisy，收益可能有限。

name: Weak/noisy reasoning traces
description: 作者明确把 trace quality 作为失败条件，而非声称 TAQ 对任意数据都有效。

name: Other supervision paradigms untested
description: 知识蒸馏等 supervision paradigm 只作为可能扩展，留待 future work。

description: 训练使用 OpenThought-3 Math subset；LiveCodeBench/MMLU 只提供小范围 transfer/task-boundary evidence。

description: DGX Spark 不支持 TensorRT-LLM native NVFP4 KV path，吞吐实验使用 FP8 KV（W4A4KV8）；B200 才用 W4A4KV4。

name: Aggregate-only uncertainty
description: 虽声明平均 8 seeds，表格/曲线未给标准差、置信区间、bootstrap 或 per-seed dispersion。

name: No formal guarantee
description: PDF 没有 theorem/lemma/proof 或收敛/准确率保证；Eq. (1)–(3) 和 Algorithm 1 是定义与校准程序。

name: Independent evaluation separation
description: 模型选择、SEM entropy 与 AIME outcome 的关系被实证检查，但未提供独立 hold-out evaluator 或与训练选择解耦的 human metric。

name: auction-model scope
description: The main guarantee assumes a discrete single-item first-price auction, bids bounded by valuations, uniform tie-breaking, and no-swap regret.

name: epsilon-k gap
description: The lower guarantee has epsilon k^2 dependence while the construction has epsilon dependence, leaving a stated gap.

name: empirical-theory mismatch
description: The experiments are said to converge faster than Theorem 2.6 predicts; the paper conjectures the right bound.

name: Bayesian theorem boundary
description: Bayesian evidence is experimental, and extending the dual-fitting approach there is future work.

name: simulation reporting
description: The plots do not report seeds, repeats, error expression, implementation details, or a quantitative CDF distance.

name: societal-impact discussion
description: The impact statement does not identify a specific societal consequence needing emphasis.

name: no deep-learning runtime gain in introduction
description: The Introduction states that no effective gains are observed in runtime for the GPT-2 result.

name: gradient-computation efficiency
description: GPT-2 final-PPL improvements do not translate into tangible speed-ups because IVON-PoCoMo needs more gradient computations.

name: data-example accounting
description: The ImageNet result is difficult to beat under data-examples-seen or gradient-evaluation accounting.

name: deep-learning generality
description: The conclusion says deep learning does not yet receive speed-ups similar to convex problems.

name: ImageNet tuning budget
description: ImageNet alpha=0.6 was not overly tuned because of computational constraints, and no momentum was tried.

name: replicate uncertainty reporting
description: Figures and Table 1 contain no reported error bars, confidence intervals, seed count or replicate aggregation rule.

name: formal limitations section
description: There is no section headed Limitations; limitations are distributed across Introduction, Results, Conclusion and Appendix F.

name: 独立局限章节
description: Conclusion 后直接进入 Acknowledgements/Impact Statement；没有列失败条件、任务外 transfer 或性能下界。

name: 任务与数据范围
description: 实证固定在三类任务十数据集；五个无官方划分数据集使用随机 20% test，未见跨 subject/session 去重说明。

name: 输入顺序与下采样假设
description: Event Cloud 按 chronological order 处理且不具 permutation invariance；点数通过固定 downsampling 给定。

name: 部署与计算边界
description: 低延迟/edge 结论由 RTX 4090、服务器和 200 MHz Zynq FPGA 测量支持；没有实际机器人、可穿戴或功耗曲线。
evidence_sections: Table 6|4.7 Hardware Efficiency and Edge Deployability

name: 任务外泛化与因果识别
description: 未测试检测、分割、跟踪或任务外传递；消融为固定数据集与单点结果，不能分离组件效应的 run-to-run 稳定性。
evidence_sections: 4.6 Ablation Study|4.6.2 Scalability to Event Number

name: 隐私/影响边界

name: accent control
description: Input-language accent intensity cannot be controlled; authors suggest accent annotations and inference conditioning.

name: coarse alignment assumptions
description: The pipeline still uses sentence mapping, punctuation timing and TTS to construct training pairs.

description: Long-form data is synthesized by three TTS systems and short-form data is filtered Europarl-ST; real interpretation distribution is not evaluated.

name: uncertainty and replication reporting
description: Objective tables have no uncertainty; Table 2 gives ± without defining its type; seeds and repeats are absent.

name: metric dependence
description: BLEU process reward uses text stream and reference; ASR metrics and LAAL use Whisper outputs; naturalness is checked later by human ratings.

name: language scope
description: Main task is four X-to-English directions; Italian is an input adaptation experiment.

name: voice-transfer risk
description: Impact Statement acknowledges spoofing risk and gives a comparative lower-risk rationale without a dedicated attack evaluation.

name: restricted program space
description: MCTS block size/repetition are at most 4; POLAR uses K_max=4 and single-repeat.

name: MCTS cost
description: MCTS is diagnostic and per-input search is described as expensive; N_sim and runtime are absent.

name: domain coverage
description: Experiments focus on mathematical reasoning, ASDiv/MAWPS and MMLU-Pro.

name: latency coverage
description: Latency is measured only on Qwen1.5 with 24 layers and DM-1/DM-5 examples.

name: statistical uncertainty
description: No seed dispersion, intervals, tests or per-example failures.

name: high-stakes safety
description: Impact Statement requests robustness, calibration, interpretability and safety before high-stakes use.

name: realizability and fixed-feature scope
description: The central theorem assumes a realizable teacher, fixed feature map, bounded features, overparameterization, and a small weight-decay regime.

name: non-realizable ridge regression
description: Section 6 names non-realizable ridge regression, including label noise, as an open end-to-end theorem question.

name: nonlinear theorem gap
description: The paper says current analysis does not identify a nonlinear hyperparameter realization and that NTK closeness does not prove persistent poor generalization.

name: small-lambda agnostic failure mode

name: metric boundary
description: Regression squared loss generally decays smoothly; the plateau can be restored by a threshold surrogate, whose theory is left open.

name: empirical uncertainty disclosure
description: Outside Figure 1, the paper does not report run count, aggregation, uncertainty or inferential details for the main empirical figures.

name: Informational versus causal score
description: The L1 proximity score measures representation contribution; perturbation evaluation is the paper's separate causal-faithfulness check.

name: Residual target-length term
description: Appendix B keeps scalar O(M·N) attention aggregation, although it treats it as lightweight relative to vector work.

name: Attention-map cache
description: Explicit attention maps require O(L·N²) space; on-the-fly recomputation trades compute for memory.

name: Semantic cancellation
description: Opposing token semantics can partially cancel before proximity; the paper records it as a caveat even though experiments did not show damage.

name: Diffuse evidence
description: Many weakly contributing tokens can diffuse attribution and leave important evidence outside top ranks.

name: Structural-token salience
description: Formatting or connective tokens can receive attribution beyond their semantic role due to residual-stream participation.

name: Uncertainty reporting
description: Main RISE/MAS/Recovery tables provide no seeds, intervals, or significance test; Table 9 prints ± without defining its statistic.

name: Deployment evaluation
description: The paper evaluates benchmarked attribution rather than an end-to-end agent deployment or operator decision study.

name: One-dimensional value-conditioned intensity
description: The conclusion states that the interface models intensity as a one-dimensional scalar conditioned on a specified value target.

name: Evaluation-call overhead
description: Ranking-based evaluation introduces additional LLM-call overhead.

name: Misuse and data/profile bias
description: Impact Statement states that steering may amplify harmful ideologies or manipulate expression, and databases/profiles may encode or reinforce bias.

name: Exact dose response and multi-value composition
description: Controlled intensities are not always exact, especially in negative directions and multi-value compositions.

name: Coverage of values
description: The study primarily covers 32 mid-level values and calls for broader inventory including user-friendly anchors and finer sub-values.

name: Personalization at scale
description: The study does not integrate personalization at scale and names user texts, dialogue histories, preference traces, LoRA, retrieval, and hybrid profiling as future inputs.

name: Downstream long-form / planning / multi-agent interactions
description: These interaction settings are not fully explored.

name: Unfiltered generated negative content
description: Appendix D.4 explicitly says a subset of harmful words and sentences was filtered, so the PDF does not provide an unfiltered qualitative sample set.

name: pretrained ViFM bias can propagate to reward and policy
description: The explicit Limitations paragraph says inherent ViFM biases may be reflected in the learned reward and resulting policy, motivating evaluation before safety-critical deployment.

name: OT computation grows with preference-label count
description: The authors state that computing the OT plan becomes more expensive for larger datasets and point to approximate or hierarchical transport.

name: policy family limited to standard Gaussian policies
description: Appendix D says current evaluations focus on standard Gaussian policies and treats generative/flow/VLA alignment as future work.
evidence_sections: D. Extended Discussion on Broader Context and Future Directions

name: representation quality may limit precision manipulation
description: Appendix D identifies representation quality for nuanced behaviors as a determinant and suggests self-supervised/3D improvements.
evidence_sections: D. Extended Discussion on Broader Context and Future Directions

name: scripted labels dominate benchmark evidence
description: Most benchmark labels use ground-truth scripted teachers; human-teacher analysis is an Appendix extension and walker2d drops.
evidence_sections: 5.1. Setups / footnote 2|C.4. Preference Learning from Human Teachers

name: robustness scope is limited
description: Visual robustness is tested on two MetaWorld tasks and a finite set of nuisance families with labeled segments fixed.

name: real-robot evidence has a small denominator
description: Table 3 reports only 10 episodes per task and covers two tasks; no uncertainty is reported.

name: “any offline RL algorithm” is untested beyond IQL
description: The interface claim is broad, but the experiment instantiates only IQL.

name: limited visual perception and reasoning
description: VJA is less effective when a model cannot infer the editing intent from visual cues; failed visual reasoning yields unchanged or invalid outputs.

name: world-knowledge dependence of defense
description: The defense relies on a pre-aligned VLM and is less effective for fabricated or misleading information requiring large and up-to-date world knowledge.

name: judge dependence
description: MLLM judges disagree in EV/HS/HRR and human evaluators assign lower HS/HRR; default Gemini is a chosen evaluator, not a human ground truth.
evidence_sections: §4.4 Comparison of MLLMs and Human Judges|Table 6

name: visual-prompt sensitivity
description: Colors, languages, fonts, sizes, and shapes can substantially alter EV/HS and model rankings, especially for models with weaker visual perception.

name: small sensitivity sample
description: The sensitivity study uses seven images, so its variable-specific fluctuations do not establish all-dataset robustness.

name: selected qualitative cases
description: A.3 deliberately chooses one representative case with the most salient policy-violating effect per category; these images illustrate behavior but do not describe output frequencies.

name: runtime and deployment details
description: Table 5 omits runtime units and detailed timing configuration, while commercial API calls and local V100 deployments are mixed.

name: scope of model coverage
description: Main tables use a limited set of commercial/open models; LongCat appears in appendix analyses and the prose count of victim models is inconsistent.
evidence_sections: §4.1 Main Results|§4.4 Comparison of MLLMs and Human Judges

name: Nonconstructive general covers
description: Theorem 2 guarantees existence but constructing ε-covers can be computationally expensive.

name: Optimization gap
description: The paper does not guarantee standard gradient descent converges to parameters that generalize.

name: Algorithmic scope
description: The stated analysis is restricted to polynomial-time algorithms.

name: Theorem 16 depth and aggregation restrictions
description: Depth is exactly K and aggregation dimension is one in the main SSSP construction.

name: Exponential scaling in K
description: η and path training-edge scales grow exponentially in K in Theorem 16.

name: Marked source requirement
description: SSSP instances explicitly mark the source node to expose the dynamic program initial condition.

name: Mixed aggregation proof gap
description: Theorem 3 proof is tailored to individual aggregation mechanisms, not their mixtures.

name: Empirical reporting boundary
description: Tables report three-seed averages but do not name the ± statistic or include hypothesis tests.

name: No dedicated limitations section
description: The document has no section titled Limitations; the conclusion also does not introduce a structured boundary section.

name: High-precision manipulation remains hard
description: Section 4.5 explicitly says high-precision manipulation remains challenging.

name: XR-1 tiny-object failure example
description: Appendix J gives TK2-CollectScrews as a precision/localization failure that can miss or drop a tiny screw.

name: Training cost
description: Stage 1 and Stage 2 each consume roughly 38,400 A100 GPU-hours; each embodiment fine-tune is about 576 GPU-hours.

name: Impact/ethics analysis
description: The Impact Statement says no societal consequences are specifically highlighted.

name: data_privacy_and_attribution
description: Dgen^ctx 未显式移除 PR developer identifiers，可能导致 contributor names memorization。

name: evaluation_sensitivity
description: 少数 test cases 依赖手工 patched harness，作者称这引入额外 variance。

name: scope
description: 只覆盖一个 base model family 和一个 benchmark；其他 family 与更真实 agentic tasks 留待未来。

name: reporting_granularity_gap
description: 论文没有 seed、硬件/训练时长/FLOPs、task-level uncertainty、human/deployment evaluation 或细组件消融。

name: Early-stopping scope
description: The main diffusion guarantees first sample the early-stopped p1; reaching pdata requires a metric conversion and a σ0 choice.

name: Refined-condition scope
description: The refined analysis focuses on the variance-exploding setting and requires non-uniform operator/Frobenius controls, including Assumption 4.8 under p̃k.

name: Proximal-oracle exactness
description: Appendix G assumes zero error in the proximal point for simplicity; nonzero-error analysis is only referred to prior work.

name: Empirical validation
description: The work explicitly describes itself as primarily theoretical and leaves implementation and experimental evaluation for future work.

name: Concurrent-work comparison
description: Appendix A says the concurrent method uses Gaussian-convolution, sub-exponential score-error, and Lipschitz-score assumptions; the paper does not collapse the approaches to one uniformly measured setting.

name: Task scope
description: The stated representative scope is general reasoning in mathematics and coding.

name: RL model scope
description: JustGRPO post-training is applied to LLaDA-Instruct; three models are used for pre-RL Pass@k comparisons.

name: Causal identification
description: Connector entropy is measured during decoding, but no fork-level intervention or counterfactual context manipulation is reported.

name: Baseline comparability
description: Table 1 combines quoted results with heterogeneous decoding, update, fine-tuning, and data settings; Table 2 only aligns selected baselines.

name: Uncertainty reporting
description: No random-seed count, variance, uncertainty band, significance test, or interval is reported for the point estimates.

name: Compute and deployment
description: Exact likelihood requires per-position forward evaluations; efficiency evidence is a single GSM8K curve on 16×H100.

name: Bidirectional refinement
description: Iterative revision of already-decoded outputs is proposed as future work, not evaluated.

name: Population-marginal path non-identifiability
description: Multiple laws on paths can produce the same population marginals; theory uses the canonical continuity-equation ODE.

name: WLM scope may exclude other systems
description: The paper says population dynamics of other systems may not obey a Wasserstein least-action principle.
evidence_sections: Limitations and Directions for Future Work

name: WLM-system identifiability is unresolved
description: The authors state open expressivity/identifiability questions and only conjecture uniqueness under additional conditions.
evidence_sections: Limitations and Directions for Future Work

name: Trajectory semantics are restricted
description: The method models canonical ODE trajectories; Navier-Stokes and Schroedinger trajectories are left for future work.
evidence_sections: Limitations and Directions for Future Work

name: Simulation-based training cost
description: The stated largest practical barrier is simulating dynamics during training; attempts at simulation-free learning were unsuccessful because estimation errors propagate downstream.
evidence_sections: Limitations and Directions for Future Work

name: EB early stopping
description: WLM did not use a validation set for early stopping, unlike the cited OT-MFM comparison.

name: Boids qualitative detail loss
description: The authors state WLM rollouts lack some finer details despite matching migrations.

name: Initial velocity sensitivity
description: True velocity helps the Boids model; zero velocity has higher reported forecast W1 in Table 7.

name: Statistical reporting incompleteness
description: No global definition for plus/minus quantities, no significance tests, and no multiple-comparison procedure are stated.

name: Broader-impact boundary
description: The paper notes potential malicious use of population prediction but says it does not see significant risk because the theory primarily concerns cellular and molecular systems.

name: group_hyperparameter
description: The model requires pre-specifying group count and group size; dummy/inactive components can be suppressed, but selection remains a model-selection or domain-knowledge challenge.

name: linear_connectivity
description: Direct connectivity interpretation is limited to linear encoder and decoder; nonlinear maps improve flexibility but complicate connectivity estimation.

name: missing_external_inputs
description: The real-world experiments omit external task or stimulus inputs; integrating them is future work for task-dependent dynamics and input-driven connectivity.

name: rank_one_expressiveness
description: M1 K=2 rank-1 latent dynamics do not capture the task trajectories as well as rank-2 groups.

name: overspecified_efficiency
description: Overly large group-rank settings impair efficiency and model quality in the mouse experiment.
evidence_sections: 4.3 Mouse dorsal cortex voltage imaging data

name: real_ground_truth
description: Real-data latent structure is unknown, so task alignment, TC and maps are indirect evidence rather than a direct latent recovery test.

name: no_explicit_limitations_section
description: No standalone Limitations section exists in pp.1–29; boundary material is distributed across Appendix A/H/G/I and Impact Statement.

name: label_scope
description: The work uses first-stage closed 8-way labels and excludes expanded secondary-label taxonomy; integration is left for future work.

name: cross_corpus_mapping
description: IEMOCAP maps Excited to Happiness, excludes Frustrated and Other, and lacks Contempt.

name: compute_cost
description: Larger K adds tool-augmented latency; K=12 is said to increase wall-time by about 50% over K=8.

name: prompt_fidelity
description: Appendix prompts are simplified but faithful and condense some detailed definitions and repetitive constraints.

name: deployment_ethics
description: Impact Statement acknowledges intrusive surveillance and emotional manipulation risks, proposing audit trail as facilitation of oversight.

name: statistical_reporting_gap
description: Tables show point estimates; the type of Figure 4 ± and seed-level uncertainty are not stated.

name: Population descriptor rather than training input
description: ESD is introduced for theoretical analysis and is not supplied to a training algorithm.

name: Fixed-eigenbasis theorem scope
description: The rigorous OP-GF result treats eigenvalue learning under a fixed eigenbasis.

name: Evolving-eigenfunction theorem unavailable
description: Pathwise ESD is defined and illustrated, but a general theorem for evolving eigenfunctions is deferred.

name: OP-GF condition burden
description: Theorem 5.2 requires strong/weak signal separation, pairwise conditions, and top-block spectral conditions.

name: RKHS bounded-target and regularity conditions
description: RKHS claims use a bounded target and a (K,n)-regular kernel condition; the lower-bound scope is correspondingly qualified.

name: Out-of-span target error
description: For f* outside the kernel span, the appendix adds irreducible approximation error rather than claiming it is removable by spectral regularization.

name: Empirical eigensystem estimation
description: The paper explicitly does not analyze statistical estimation of empirical eigenvalues or eigenfunctions.

name: Comprehensive depth study
description: The numerical depth observation is not promoted to a comprehensive general-model study.

name: math-biased taxonomy
description: MMLU-Pro taxonomy discovery yields taxonomies biased toward mathematical reasoning, making non-math benchmark evaluation challenging.

name: steering-strength confound
description: The coefficient MLP is trained jointly with category vectors; alternate coefficient selection could isolate factors further.

name: SFT recovery alternative
description: Lower SFT recovery could represent real mechanism modification or limitations in category-vector optimization.

name: deployment and ethics evaluation
description: The Impact Statement identifies no specific societal consequence; there is no deployment study or standalone ethics evaluation.

name: residual_contamination
description: All benchmark problems are from 2025, but the paper acknowledges residual contamination risk and relies on recency/minimal expected exposure.

name: undergraduate_scope
description: The benchmark covers problems up to undergraduate level and may not capture research-level theorem proving.

name: judge_fallibility
description: OPC-R1-8B is acknowledged as fallible and may misjudge proofs; the main sycophancy judge is also evaluated only on a 250-response sample.

name: synthetic_self_syc
description: The self-sycophancy experiment uses an intercepted/replaced response rather than a naturally generated self-theorem.

name: unverified_fine_tuning_perturbations
description: Half of the fine-tuning source is perturbed without the final human verification step for scalability.

name: trained_model_unavailable
description: The trained model is omitted from supplementary material due to file size and only planned for future release.

name: domain_imbalance
description: Algebra problems are slightly underrepresented because many perturbed inequalities are easy to disprove.

name: unreported_seed_dispersion
description: No random seeds, repeated runs, or seed-level dispersion are given, so point-rate stability cannot be assessed from the paper.

name: simulator realism
description: Persona, cognitive-bias, and group-conflict injection cannot fully capture emotional, noisy, and environmentally complex real wards.

name: modality scope
description: Vision-language is scoped to text and static medical images, excluding auscultation audio, physical-exam signals, procedure video, and ambient ward interactions.

name: longitudinal learning
description: The 200-student study is a short-term interaction study; longitudinal trials are needed for durable learning gains and clinical-reasoning behavior.

name: latency and tokens
description: Explicit internal thinking increases generated tokens and approximately linear latency growth with student number.

name: deployment boundary
description: The system is strictly designed for educational simulation, not treating real patients.

name: future multimodal work
description: The paper calls for ethically approved real-world audiovisual ward-round data and future real-time audio/video streams.

name: No standalone limitations section
description: Boundaries appear in Discussion, Assumptions, and theorem statements rather than a dedicated heading.

name: Safe reference policy
description: CPC assumes an initial safe policy whose true risk is controlled at alpha.

name: Mutual absolute continuity
description: The main theorem assumes mutual absolute continuity of the safe, optimized, and constrained policies.

name: Marginal rather than individual guarantee
description: Risk is controlled on average over context and calibration-data draws; individual-context safety is less informed.

name: Context-distribution stability
description: A shift can require recalibration or leave a risk-control gap.

name: Likelihood tractability
description: Closed-form likelihoods are assumed; density or density-ratio estimation is suggested conditionally when they are intractable.

name: Synthetic task structure
description: Tabular feasibility is constructed from PCA and sequence optimization uses procedural Ehrlich functions.
evidence_sections: F.2 Feasibility Constraint Construction|G.1 Ehrlich Test Functions

name: Practical approximate weights
description: Exact permutation weights are declared intractable and replaced by a past-policy mixture plus empirical maximum; no matching finite-sample approximation result is stated.
evidence_sections: 4.2 Conformal Policy Control|D.1.3 Conformal Mixture Weight Approximation

name: training_throughput_overhead
description: VGS requires an additional no-image-conditioned forward pass and is reported to cost approximately 1.375 times training time per step.

name: teacher_calibration_dependence
description: If multimodal and unimodal teacher distributions are indistinguishable and the visual gradient is approximately zero, VGS reduces to standard distillation and cannot repair teacher perceptual blindness.

name: seed_and_repeat_reporting
description: No random seed, independent training-repeat count, or seed-level aggregation is stated in the full PDF.

name: uncertainty_reporting
description: Except for Figure 3 mean plus or minus 0.5 STD, main tables and curves lack stated uncertainty intervals, test results, or multiplicity handling.

name: qualitative_sampling_rule
description: Appendix F gives four side-by-side examples but no selection rule, denominator, failure rate, or human evaluation protocol.

name: external_baseline_breadth
description: The main benchmark table compares standard OPD and VGS under a shared teacher, with no external SOTA row or broader non-distillation baseline.

name: scope_of_domains
description: 作者选择 music/genome 是因其似乎需要位置—内容分离，并承认 human language 是否满足这一条件更不明确。

name: compute_and_memory
description: 额外 2L²d FLOPs；所选通用实现对 complex-valued keys/values 使用两倍 memory/bandwidth，作者称其较慢。

name: uncertainty_coverage
description: 仅 Indirect Indexing 有 3-seed SD；Tables 2–6 与 Figures 2–7 缺乏 uncertainty。

name: dedicated_limitations_section
description: PDF 没有独立 Limitations 小节；Impact Statement 仅覆盖 societal/dual-use 边界。

name: hardware_runtime
description: 没有 GPU/CPU、峰值显存、吞吐或 wall-clock 报告。

name: formal_guarantee
description: 没有 accuracy 或 generalization theorem；理论部分是代数推导和 FLOPs bookkeeping。

name: dual_use
description: Impact Statement 列出 protein folding、drug discovery、music、conversation 与 deepfake/harmful-content 的潜在影响和风险。

name: dedicated limitations section
description: PDF 没有 Limitations 标题；Impact Statement 是通用社会影响表述。

name: theory and guarantee boundary
description: 四个编号公式均为方法定义/更新，未提供 theorem、lemma、收敛保证、误差界或复杂度定理。

description: validation loss 使用 physics-induced pseudo-label，而非真实密集标签；伪标签偏差没有独立校验。

description: Dθ 参数化、K/τ/ρ/β、superpixel 参数、训练硬件和软件版本未报告；没有 supplementary。

description: 表格为点估计；100 runs/五 seeds 未给聚合、方差、误差带或检验。

name: data and deployment scope
description: 实证限四个 ISTD benchmark、single-point supervision 和七种 detector；没有真实部署、端到端训练成本或更广数据分布。

name: no dedicated limitations section
description: The paper has no section titled Limitations; boundaries are distributed across results and Appendix B-C.

name: high-ratio success degradation
description: Success declines at 40% for OpenVLA-OFT/π0.5 and beyond 40% in Figure 5.

name: real-robot task losses
description: Ours has fewer successes on Task 2 and Task 3 despite lower latency.

name: workspace-boundary deployment boundary
description: Most real-robot failures occur near the workspace boundary; authors conjecture finer spatial cues are lost.

description: All reported measurements use RTX 3090; cross-hardware latency is not evaluated.

name: missing uncertainty and seeds
description: Success and latency reports omit seed/repeat and uncertainty information.

name: missing ethics/broader-impact analysis
description: No ethics, broader-impact, energy, or societal-impact section appears in the 12-page PDF.

description: High/low α and p produce lag, instability, or noise sensitivity; settings vary by model.

name: adapter-sweep compute cost
description: ID 估计需要训练多个不同大小的 adapters；作者称直接用该指标优化 reasoning strategy 的计算成本高。

description: layer-wise projection/PEFT 形成上界，可能松于底层 Kolmogorov complexity；替代 PEFT 的相对排序留作 future work。

description: 主要实证只覆盖给定 reasoning trajectories 的 fine-tuning；其他 post-training settings 未在本文测试。

description: Impact Statement 提醒 intrinsic dimensionality 可能反映特定 model family 或 dataset 的 artifacts。

description: The conclusion says the work focuses on small-scale datasets rather than ImageNet.

name: scope of hardware claim
description: Energy is estimated through E1/E2/E3 formulas and configurations, not measured on a deployed chip.

description: Table 1 combines different model families, pre-trained-ReLU rows, and author implementations.

name: statistical_reporting
description: The definition of ±, seed count, uncertainty method, and hypothesis testing are absent.

name: DVS failure denominator
description: The claim that competing methods typically fail to converge has no failure count or operational criterion.

name: No standalone limitations section
description: 主文 §5 后直接进入 p.10 Impact Statement/References；Impact Statement 不是 method/experiment limitations。

name: Conditional decorrelation assumptions
description: Lemma 3.1 要求 EV orthogonality 和 EV–learned independence；selective version 以 small ε 表示 mild dependence。

description: α is tuned based on downstream task data, so the framework's use is not fully task-parameter-free。

description: GPT-OSS pruning is adopted due to resource constraints, then results depend on retaining 75% or 100% capacity。

description: pruned 75%-expert SSMoE has 30.8 on GSM8K versus Original 36.8; full capacity yields 43.4。

description: 大多数 LLM/VLM results lack seed, repetitions, uncertainty or data-leakage control; only Table 1 and Table 4 offer limited statistical information。

description: Impact Statement acknowledges systemic web-data biases and high LLM training computation; it does not test these for SSMoE。

description: The conclusion limits the work to two pretrained dLLMs and four elementary reasoning benchmarks; other models and domains remain unknown.

name: WDDO instability
description: WDDO has the fastest initial reward increase in Figure 4 but is described as unstable afterward.

name: High-F instability
description: Resampling frequencies above 24 may introduce slight late-stage instability when reward is high.

name: Early warm-up disadvantage
description: DMPO often yields lower rewards than d1 in the first 1,000 steps; the stated explanation is uncertain because it is phrased as “potentially”.

name: Zero-temperature diversity boundary
description: The α=0 extension can no longer guarantee diversity in the target distribution.

name: Approximate variance-reduction argument
description: Using the negative ELBO rather than exact sequence log probability makes the baseline variance-reduction statement approximate.

name: Statistical reporting boundary
description: The PDF does not state seeds, repeated runs, tests, or a definition of the displayed curve bands.

name: non-negative-input scope
description: The principal fast MVP result is for entry-wise non-negative vectors; the general mixed-sign problem remains open.

description: The lower bound for mixed signs uses an asymmetric-up-to-one-vector K′ with a plus-sign kernel, not the original symmetric Kx problem.

name: conditional hardness
description: All lower bounds rely on OV/SETH.

description: The improved MVP theorem is only Gaussian/Laplacian; Exponential and Rational Quadratic use the slower existing subroutine for the eigenvalue application.

description: The KDE limits are arguments for natural classes/ideas rather than universal running-time lower bounds.

description: Experiments test the top-eigenvalue power method, use random-sampling KDE, and do not measure all upper-bound tasks.

description: No standalone Limitations or Conclusion heading is visible in the 50-page PDF; limits are distributed across technical sections and Open Questions.

name: additive_probe_and_generality
description: The layer-error additivity assumption is described as strong; C.3 says it is not an exact theorem/solution and cannot be shown generally for arbitrary deep nonlinear networks.

name: linear_theory_scope
description: §4 expressly proves claims for linear models; Appendix B adds initialization, global-minimizer, and spectral assumptions.

name: optimization_and_data
description: Performance depends on training-set quality and consolidation amount; better optimization or more data may improve the frontier.

name: adaptive_routing
description: The source does not evaluate budget-conditioned or input-adaptive routing policies.

name: training_efficiency
description: Full-rank factors add about 2× memory overhead, preclude fused dense kernels, and make high-rank training about 2× slower than a single dense forward.

name: inference_scope
description: Inference gains are stated for sufficiently large matrices and sequences where computation is bottlenecked; Figure 10 provides one runtime setup.

name: baseline_scope
description: Flextron and LlamaFlex are not benchmarked; Appendix A gives different mechanism, unavailable implementation, and proprietary-data reasons.

name: dino_protocol
description: DINOv3 backbone is not fine-tuned on proxy data; the authors state fine-tuning all weights can potentially improve accuracy.

name: societal_impact
description: The Impact Statement supplies no paper-specific societal consequence to highlight.

name: Fixed-point convergence
description: Ideal conditional diffusion-matching uses unavailable target samples and is approximated with detached sampler endpoints; no global convergence guarantee for replay-buffer dynamics.

name: Riemannian scope
description: The efficient extension depends on closed-form conditional drifts for constant-curvature manifolds; general manifolds and constrained spaces remain future work.

name: Downstream deployment
description: Biases or inaccuracies could influence downstream decisions in drug discovery and materials science.

name: exact_kr_infeasibility
description: Exact KR dual LP has Theta(n^2) Lipschitz constraints and is infeasible at vocabulary scale; implementation uses a feasible-potential alternating surrogate.

name: fixed_f_scope
description: Theorem 3.4 is exact for fixed feasible f; the paper does not state a global-optimality theorem for the complete alternating loop.

name: singleton_degeneracy
description: When beta is at or below lambda, a fixed-f update can collapse to a singleton; practical guidance selects beta>lambda.

name: candidate_pool_condition
description: Top-m pooling is exact only under a sufficient condition involving the full vocabulary phi-prefix; the actual pool is top probability tokens.

name: evaluation_scope
description: Evaluation covers three instruction-tuned models, four primary benchmarks, three creative prompts, and GPT-4o judging; absolute judge scores depend on model/prompt.

name: baseline_provenance
description: GSM8K/GPQA baseline accuracies are quoted from Baghaei Potraghloo et al.; judge tasks use a fixed local protocol.

name: runtime_reporting_scope
description: Table 4 supplies ms/token but no hardware, repeat count, or dispersion.

name: deployment_impact_not_measured
description: Impact Statement says decoding may shift refusal, toxicity, bias, and hallucination prevalence and recommends target-setting evaluation; none are evaluated in the reported experiments.

name: dedicated limitations section
description: No heading or prose block named Limitations appears between the main text and References.

name: task and tool scope
description: The evaluated scope is K12 geometric interleaved reasoning built around executable GeoGebra states; transfer beyond geometry remains a future direction.

name: metric scope
description: Appendix A says code/image surface similarity is unreliable as a geometric-correctness proxy and uses it diagnostically.

name: reporting omissions
description: Seeds, human-rater count and rubric, complete denominators, GPU/model details, leakage controls, and release URL are not reported.

description: The text calls the three conditions necessary and sufficient, yet gives no theorem/proof; RL and SFT also differ in objective and sampling, leaving single-variable causal identification open.

name: Deployment privacy
description: A memory bank storing real interactions may inadvertently capture sensitive user information.

name: Systematic failure study
description: No systematic failure-case study or failure-count denominator is reported.

name: No dedicated limitations section
description: The paper has no section headed Limitations; scope restrictions occur in theorem statements, a footnote, and prose.

name: Parameter and promise scope

name: Privacy-parameter scaling
description: Theorem 2.1 footnote fixes epsilon and delta for exposition and says scaling with them is not the focus.

name: Tightness outside selected regimes
description: The paper states that outside its chosen h,k,w setting, the obtained trade-off is not necessarily tight and remains an open problem.

name: Extension domain
description: Theorem 2.3 has d>=2 or U>=2 conditions; broader applicability is phrased as belief in the conclusion.

name: Impact/deployment evidence
description: The Impact statement does not identify a specific societal consequence and the paper contains no deployment evaluation.

name: finite test-suite oracle imperfection

name: truncation-induced false negatives

description: The ODE permits time-dependent rates, but experiments fix rates and defer policy/rewarder co-evolution.

name: finite-horizon evidence for fate
description: The authors only train for 1,410 steps and remain agnostic about exact asymptotic behavior.

name: support barrier / cold capability

name: mode-map identifiability
description: The proposed coarse-graining map ϕ is asserted to be reasonably invariant but is not constructed or validated in the coding experiment.

name: ethics/deployment discussion

name: extreme_stochasticity
description: Extreme stochasticity or large policy divergence can let the penalty dominate and produce overly conservative early updates.

name: high_dimensional_training

name: dog_run_sensitivity
